notes.title: [Edited] Patch Notes and Update + Known Issues - October 28th (PDT)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/46fedac2dd726d9284ca3a995c68ff5ac6c00ee2.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Greeting Adventurers,[/b][/h3]

Thank you all for waiting for a long time.

[h3]The October Update that was introduced from the Roadmap has been performed through the patch today.[/h3]
Check out a variety of update news of the world of Bless Unleashed including new equipment, the official PvP Season, and new Dungeon/Boss.

Together with the update, some issues found in the Bless Unleashed PC version have also been fixed.
Please check out the details below.



[h2][b]■ New Update[/b][/h2]


[h3][b][Dungeon] [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=n7vF9r89X78;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]- New Time Dungeon has been added.[/b]

[b][Arena Challenges (2 Players) : Required Lv.22 / Required Gear Score : 481] [/b][list]
[*] The Cursed Knight
[*] The Fiendlord Executioner
[/list]
 
[b][Lair Challenges (5 Players) : Required Lv.40 / Required Gear Score : 1516] [/b][list]
[*] Harpy Queen's Nest
[*] Chamber of the Ancient
[*] Archon of Fire
[*] Infernal Execution Grounds
- A giant dragon “Elfirkraag” stays in this place.
- The ground here was burnt by the Elfirkraag’s flame.
[/list]
 
[b][Dungeon (5 Players) : Required Lv.35 / Required Gear Score : 1262] [/b][list]
[*] Rutus Mines - Halls of the Dead
[*] Savantis Mausoleum - Lich's Respite
[/list]

[b][[Abyssal] Dungeons (5 Players) : Required Lv.40 / Required Gear Score : 1516] [/b][list]
[*] [Abyssal] Dreamscale Ruins - Hall of the Eclipse
[*] [Abyssal] Rutus Mines - Halls of the Dead
[/list]
 
[b]▶ Time Dungeon Schedule in October (Oct. 28th ~ Nov. 3rd)[/b]
 
[b]Arena Challenges (2 Players)[/b][list]
[*] The Pagar Champion
[*] The Fiendlord Executioner
[/list]
 
[b]Lair Challenges (5 Players)[/b][list]
[*] Shadow Visions Lair Challenge
[*] Infernal Execution Grounds (Lv.40)
[/list]
 
[b]Dungeon (5 Players)[/b][list]
[*] Rutus Mines - Depths of Corruption 
[*] The Nightspire - Abyss of Evil
[/list]
 
[b][Abyssal] Dungeons (5 Players)[/b][list]
[*] [Abyssal] Dreamscale Ruins - Hall of the Eclipse (Lv.40)
[*] [Abyssal] Kobold Lair - Infernal Kitchen
[/list]
 
 
[u][h3][b][S+] Equipment[/b][/h3][/u]
1. S+ equipment can be obtained from Lv.40 “Lair Challenges (5 Players)” and “Dungeon (5 Players)”.
2. S+ equipment has the same basic stats and Gear Score as S equipment, but has additional 2 options.
3. “Superior Alchemy Stone” can be obtained from salvaging S+ equipment.
 
[b]▶ Time Dungeon Reward[/b]
- Lv.40 Time Dungeon reward chest can be obtained up to 3 times a day, and it will be reset at 1AM(PDT) & 10AM(CEST) daily.
- S equipment has double change to be dropped in Lv.35 Time Dungeon compared to before.

※ Notes
1. After the update on October 28th, the 6 Lv.40 Time Dungeons will be open in order based on the Time Dungeon schedule.
2. As Lv.40 Time Dungeons are added, the whole Time Dungeon schedule will be changed on October 28th.
 

 
[h3][b][Monster][/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=Fl1C4FMpqmA;full][/previewyoutube]
- New field boss “Twisted Void Soulraiser” has been added.

º Default Level : Lv. 42
º Location : North Sperios


[h3][b][PVP][/b][/h3]
[h3][b]
1. The official PvP Season “Rising Dawn” has started in Battlefield / Warlords Arena.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/7a80f0cbdb92e4e4b0badc28d27a9507a1e004ec.png[/img]

[b]▶ “Rising Dawn” Season Schedule : October 29th, 2021 17:00  ~ January 28th, 2022 17:00 (PDT)[/b]
[b]▶ “Rising Dawn” Season Schedule : October 29th, 2021 18:00 ~ January 28th, 2022 18:00 (CEST)[/b] 

[b]▶ PVP Season Participation[/b]
- Rewards can be obtained by completing a weekly mission from Battlefield / Warlords Arena during the season.[olist]
[*] You can challenge 4 difficulty levels in Battlefield / Warlords Arena.
[*] Each level consists of 12 missions that can be done in Battlefield / Warlords Arena, and the next level is available after completing all missions of the current level.
[*] Reward can be obtained from completing each mission, and final reward can be obtained if completing all missions.
[/olist]
※ Notes
- All mission rewards of Battlefield / Warlords Arena are sent via in-game Mail.
- Weekly mission is reset every sunday at 18:00 (PDT).

[b]▶ PVP Season Rank[/b]
- PvP Rank consists of [Battlefield Rank] and [Arena Rank].
- The rank is changed according to the play result of Battlefield / Warlords Arena during the season.
- Battlefield/Arena Rank is reset after the season period.

[b]▶ Conditions of PVP Rank-up[/b]

[b]º Battlefield (15vs15)[/b]
- Battlefield XP can be obtained according to the match result.
- Battlefield Rank is increased according to the accumulation of the Battlefield XP.

* Battlefield Rank
Apprentice -> Combatant -> Veteran -> Ace -> Master -> Legend 


[b]º Warlords Arena (3vs3)[/b]
- Rank score can be obtained according to the match result.
- If you win the match, a certain score will be obtained and the rank can be increased.
- According to the match result, the Arena rank score is changed.

* Arena Rank
No Grade -> Barbarian -> Brawler -> Fighter -> Destroyer -> Ruler -> Immortal


[b]▶ PVP Season Special Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/c19820aeae549c9c7d50538406b615bc627695c2.png[/img]
- A rare title can be obtained by achieving a high rank in Battlefield / Warlords Arena during the season.
- The title will be sent to your Mailbox after the season period.


[h3][b]2. Added the challenge content that can be completed in Battlefield / Warlords Arena.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ef343e52a472f47deb35cf6949dcfb13e31ac079.png[/img]
- You can achieve various missions in Battlefield / Warlords Arena to obtain rewards.


[h3][b]3. The current Warlords Arena has been changed to a casual mode[/b][/h3]
- Some stats of Warlords Arena participants are adjusted.

[b]▶ Warlords Arena Adjustment[/b]
- The stats of all characters that join the Warlords Arena will be adjusted to default regardless of the basic stats of their equipped gears and level.[list]
[*] Adjusted Stats: Character Level, HP, Attack, Defense
[*] Non-adjusted Stats: Options of equipped gears, Skills, Bless effects
[/list]

[h3][b]4. 1vs1 Duel system has been added.[/b][/h3]
- You can have a “1vs1 duel” challenge with other players through an interaction.

[b]▶ 1vs1 Duel[/b]
1) The duel starts after 10 seconds from accepting the challenge request.
2)  The duel lasts up to 10 minutes, and the player who leaves the dueling area(40m) or reaches 1 HP first loses.
  
* During the 1vs1 Duel, “Notoriety” doesn’t increase by attacking each other.

[h3][b][UI/UX][/b][/h3]

[h3][b]1. Bag and Warehouse have a separated tab where only materials can be stored.[/b][/h3]
When you obtain a material item or store it in the Warehouse, the item will first be stored in the “Material” tab of Bag or Warehouse.

[b]2. Changed controls for “Acquiring”, “Registering”, “Upgrading” skills.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ede4075f50206f5b9d1eaf171e4c1e9a788c3121.png[/img]


[h2][b]■ Changes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b][Lumena Shop][/b][/h3]

[h3][b]1. Added a Clas Breath Drawing product that can be purchased once per week.[/b][/h3]
- You can draw up to 10 times, and it’s guaranteed to obtain 3 Epic Breaths for your class.

[h3][b]2. Added new products in Lumena Shop.[/b][/h3]
- Arctic Officer's Visor/Uniform Chest
- Celebrity Shades/Ensemble Chest
- Behemoth Mount
- Neglected Armored Strider Mount
- Time Dungeon Reward Booster


[h3][b][Crusader][/b][/h3]

[h3]■ Blessing[/h3]

[b]1) Gift of Valor[/b]
: Charge-type has been removed and Dauntless Charge-type and Daring Assault-type skills are categorized to Strike-type skills.

- Brave Assault
: The effect that reduces the cooldown of Charge-type skills has been replaced by an effect that reduces the cooldown of Strike-type skills.

- The Eternal Warrior
: The effect that increases the damage of Charge-type skills has been replaced by an effect that increases the damage of Strike-type skills.

[b]2) Mark of the Wolf[/b]
- Fang of the Wolf
: Increased the damage of Bleeding by twice.

- Howl of the Wolf
: Increased the duration of Excess Bleeding as well as Bleeding when using Shout-type skills.

- Razor Claw 
: Increased the damage of Excess Bleeding by 6.5 times.

[b]3) The Lionheart[/b]
- Roar of the Lion 
: Increased the damage of Shout-type skills from 160%~320% to 224%~448% of Attack Power.

- Shout 
: Increased the damage increase of Warcry, Great Slash, and Spinning Slash combo while Shout-type effect is activated from 20%~120% to 24%~144%.

[h3]■ Fixed Bugs[/h3]
- Fixed a bug of The Crescent Moon Blessing’s “Armed Frontline” where the damage increase of Counterattack was not applied.


[h3][b][Berserker][/b][/h3]

[h3]■ Blessing[/h3]
[b]1) The Lionheart[/b]
- Beast Lord's Attack
: Slightly increased the duration of “Attack Warning” from 3~15 to 4~15 second and the duration of “Beast Lord's Attack” from 4.5~14 to 5~14 seconds for the low levels.

- Beast Lord's Advance
: Slightly increased the duration of “Advance Warning” from 3~15 to 4~15 seconds and the duration of “Beast Lord's Advance” from 4.5~14 to 8~24 seconds for the low levels.

- Consecutive Strike
: Increased the duration of “Consecutive Strike” from 3~12.5 to 7~20 seconds.


[h3][b][Ranger][/b][/h3]

[h3]■ Blessing[/h3]
[b]1) Gift of Valor[/b]
- Ramming Arrow
: Increased the damage of Tempest Shot from 15% ~ 140% to 37.5% ~ 350%.

- Sharpshooter
: Added an effect where using “Bottomless Quiver” adds 8 stacks of the Flashing effect.

- Neural Stimulation
: Change the condition to reduce the cooldown of “Tempest Shot” from “Each successful combo hit” to “Each successful hit with Rush-type and Double Shot-type combos and skills”.

[b]2) Mark of the Wolf[/b]
- Fully Prepared
: Increased the Attack Power increase from holding special arrows from 15% ~ 60% to 17.25% ~ 69%.


[b]3) The Lionheart[/b]
- Threat of the Beast 
: Increased the damage increase per stack of Scarred from 3.5% ~ 8% to 4.59% ~ 10.48%.

[h3]■ Fixed Bugs[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the Lv.5 stats of “Fully Prepared” of “Mark of the Wolf” was not applied correctly.



[h3][b][Mage][/b][/h3]

[h3]■ Blessing[/h3]
[b]1) Gift of Valor[/b]
- Frost Circulation
: Changed so that all Frost-type skills are allowed to be charged up, not only Frost Spike.
: Removed the effect where hitting enemies with Frost Nova immediately charges Frost Spike, and added an effect where attacking enemies with Frost-type skills has a certain chance to decrease the cooldown of Arcane-type skills -1 sec.


[b]2) The Lionheart[/b]
- Chain Explosion
: Increased the damage increase of Chain Explosion and Meteor from 20 ~ 100% to 28 ~ 138%.

- Madness of Fire 
: Increased the damage increase of Meteor from 20 ~ 100% to 28 ~ 138%.

[b]3) The Crescent Moon[/b]
- Elemental Detection
: Increased the damage increase of “Flame Detection” and “Arcane Detection” from 100%~300% to 108%~324%.
: Added an effect where while Detection effect is activated, the cooldown of  the same type skills is decreased by 50%.


[h3][b] [Priest][/b][/h3]

[h3] ■ Class Skill[/h3]
[b]1) Blades of Justice[/b]
- Changed from “Holy Bolt”-type to “Holy Bolt + Smite”-type.

[h3]■ Blessing[/h3]
[b]1) Gift of Valor[/b]
- Trance
: Changed the Critical Hit Rate increase from 3.5% to 4%, and Critical Hit Damage increase to 15% per stack.


[b]2) The Lionheart[/b]
- Fervor 
: Increased the chance to obtain the effect from 10% ~ 30% to 30% ~ 75%, and increased the Attack Speed increase from 1% to 2.5%.
: Added an effect where activating the Compassion effect again when it is stacked to the maximum limit decreases the cooldown of Smite-type skills -1 sec.

[b]- Executioner [/b]
: The effect that decreases the cooldown of Smite-type skills has been replaced by the effect that increases the Attack Power of Smite-type skills +20%~100%.



[h2][b] [Item][/b][/h2]

[h3][b]■ S Equipment[/b][/h3]
[h3]1. Changed the bound option when obtaining S equipment from [Account Bound] to [Bound]. After bound, S equipment cannot be stored in the Account Warehouse.[/h3]
- The S equipment that was stored in the Account Warehouse before patch will be bound to the first character that retrieves it.
- The S equipment under an unbound state will still keep the unbound state, and it can be stored in the Account Warehouse or traded.

[h3][b]2. Changed the required item for unbinding S equipment to “Master Unbinding Scroll”.[/b][/h3]
- Currently, this item cannot be obtained, and obtaining location will be added through the future update.

[h3][b]3. Changed so that when salvaing S equipment at a Soul Pyre, “Alchemy Stone” can additionally be obtained with the original reward.[/b][/h3]
- “Alchemy Stone” is used during Rune randomization for S or lower equipment.

* Rune Randomization system will be added through the future update.


[h3][b]■ Enhancement [/b][/h3]
[h3][b]1. Adjusted so that the enhancement success rate is 100% up to Rare grade, and increased the success rate of up to +2 of Epic, Legendary, Myth.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/805e2f65cea16891845a3673821b1c7b3dc1f078.png[/img]

[h3][b]2. Changed so that when the enhancement level is maintained or destroyed, the additional success rate is applied according to the grade of the enhanced equipment.[/b][/h3]
- Maintained: Uncommon 0.1% / Rare 0.3% / Epic 0.5% / Legendary 0.7% / Myth 1%
- Destroyed: Uncommon 0.3% / Rare 0.9% / Epic 1.5% / Legendary 2.1% / Myth 3%

[h3][b]3. Changed so that Upgrade Stone and Fortification Stone are used during the Unlicensed Enhancement.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]4. Decreased the chance to destroy the equipment during the Unlicensed Enhancement to 1/4 of the original rate.[/b][/h3]


[h3][b]■ Material [/b][/h3]
[h3][b]1. Adjusted the balance for Gathering/Mining/Logging.[/b][/h3]
- The positioning density of Plant, Ore, and Tree objects is lower in the world and respawning interval is random.
- Increased the maximum amount of obtaining items from Gathering/Mining/Logging at once.
- Increased the material reward from a special monster summoned during Gathering/Mining/Logging.
- The effect that increases the amount of obtaining items from Gathering/Mining/Logging by twice(Buff item, Bless effect, Event effect) has been replaced by an effect “Amount of obtained item +1”.

[h3][b]■ Item for Taming Rate[/b][/h3]
1. Increased the “chance to capture animals” by “Call” item, and adjusted the duration from 30 mins to 10 mins.
2. Increased the “chance to capture animals” by Estate decorations, and adjusted the duration from 1 hour to 30 mins.
 - Applied Estate decorations : 'Maple Tree Swing' , 'Fountain Pool'

[h3][b][Marketplace][/b][/h3]
1. Maximum price limit is applied when listing items in the Marketplace. Items cannot be listed with a higher price than the price limit.
- The maximum price limit varies in items, and “Max. selling price” of each item can be checked in “Sell Item” window.

[h3][b][Quest][/b][/h3]

[h3][b]■ Added Quest and Changes in Major Places.[/b][/h3][olist]
[*] Added Aiden Narrative Quest “Preparations” in “Gnoll Wastes”.
[*] Changed Wanted Quest in “Ruins of Tristezza” to Aiden Reward Quest.
[*] Added 1 Aiden Reward Quest in “Padana Ruins”.
[*] Placed Beggar NPC additionally in “Ruins of Tristezza”.
- Like the current Beggar NPCs, you can receive a blessing after showing some mercy.
[*] Improved the content about “Navarra”.[/olist]
1) Changed the main quest Murder the Messengers' goal from defeating 3 secret messengers in each territory to defeating 1 secret messenger in Drysand Goblin Territory.
2) Changed the objective of “The King of Navarra” Campaign Quest from “Defeat 3 Gnoll leaders” to “Defeat 1 Gnoll leader”.
3) Changed the quest completion NPC of “Navarran Cuisine” Sidequest from “Merchant Pesoa” to “Cowherd Luis”.
4) Changed so that the Sidequest item of “Gathering Evidence” is also dropped from “Outlaw Swordsman” and “Outlaw Gladiator” not only from “Outlaw Soldier“.
5) Changed the location of the quest accepting NPC of “The Hidden Village” Sidequest from “inside Breezemane Inn” to “in front of the western gate of Navarra City”.

notes.title: [Edited]Preview of Update on October 28th
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greeting Adventurers,[/b][/h2]
 
The October update we promised in the “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1254120/view/2993196556265559156][b]Bless Unleashed PC Update Roadmap[/b][/url]” announcement will be performed on October 28th. We believe you are getting more curious as the update is only 1 week away.
 
So, for players who are looking forward to the update, we prepared “Update Preview” about the major new contents and changes of the current contents in October.
 
Since the update is soon, we want to ask for your interest and support.
 
 
 
[h1][b][New Content Update][/b][/h1]
 
[h3][b]1. New 6 Lv.40 Time Dungeons[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/981b0ab7ac06f267a49f37a7cf6acf60a0cf4007.png[/img]

[h3][b][Lair Challenge(5 Players): Required Character Level: Lv.40 / Required Gear Score : 1516][/b][/h3]
[list][*] Harpy Queen's Nest
[*] Chamber of the Ancient
[*] Archon of Fire
[*] Infernal Execution Grounds
- A giant dragon “Elfirkraag” stays in this place.
- The ground here was burnt by the Elfirkraag’s flame.[/list]

[h3][b][Dungeon(5 Players) : Required Character Level: Lv.40 / Required Gear Score : 1516] [/b][/h3]
[list][*] [Abyssal] Dreamscale Ruins - Hall of the Eclipse
[*] [Abyssal] Rutus Mines - Halls of the Dead[/list]

[b]※ Notes[/b][olist]
[*] After the update on October 28th, the 6 Lv.40 Time Dungeons will be open in order based on the Time Dungeon schedule.
[*] As Lv.40 Time Dungeons are added, the whole Time Dungeon schedule will be changed on October 28th.
[*] The first Lv.40 Time Dungeon you will see is “Infernal Execution Grounds”, Lair Challenge(5 Players).
[*] The previously announced required Gear score for Lv.40 Time Dungeon, 1574, will be adjusted to 1516.
[*]  S+ Equipment can be obtained from Lv.40 Lair Challenge Dungeon(5 Players).
[/olist]

[u][b] ▶ Time Dungeon Schedule of October (Oct. 28th ~ Nov. 3rd)[/b][/u]
- Arena Challenges (2 Players)[list]
[*] The Pagar Champion
[*] The Fiendlord Executioner
[/list]
 
- Lair Challenges (5 Players)[list]
[*] Shadow Visions Lair Challenge
[*] Infernal Execution Grounds  (Lv.40)
[/list]
 
- Dungeons (5 Players)
[list]
[*] Rutus Mines - Depths of Corruption 
[*] The Nightspire - Abyss of Evil
[/list]
 
- [Abyssal] Dungeons (5 Players)
[list]
[*] [Abyssal] Dreamscale Ruins - Hall of the Eclipse  (Lv.40)
[*] [Abyssal] Kobold Lair - Infernal Kitchen
[/list]

[u][b]▶S+ Equipment[/b][/u]
 
[b][Plate Type][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/323bbc37730468b06b9cbb4fa9a9ebc78c15900b.png[/img]
 
[b][Leather Type][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/4c20d2a687b843feb3a337fb2357ce0f9efd6f22.png[/img]
 
[b][Cloth Types] [/b]        
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/1758debc0393461cf3b509bdcf95293a5a6dbec8.png[/img]
 
 
[h3][b]2. Twisted Void Soulraiser Revenant[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/5b6093cf3668236774d5033c91f2d86e197bed1f.png[/img]
- Appears in North Sperios.
 
 
[h3][b]3. The current Warlords Arena will be changed to a casual mode[/b][/h3]
- In the casual mode of Warlords Arena, all characters are set to have the same level with basic attack and defense stats of each class.
- But, the option of the current equipment and the status of Blessings and skills will be maintained.
 

[h3][b]4. The official PvP Battlefield Season ‘Rising Dawn’ will start[/b][/h3]
- Various rewards can be obtained from completing missions through “weekly challenge” and “seasonal challenge”.
- Based on the PvP statistics, you can check your rank and get various rewards and titles.
- Battlefield Rank is given according to your Battlefield ranking.
 

[b]▶ Preview Arena Rank & Battlefield Rank[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/0748e5e4b772cc5ca23b6e8deea190208810d2cc.png[/img]
 

[h3][b]4. 1:1 Combat system will be added[/b][/h3]
- You can have a 1:1 combat with another player regardless of your notoriety.
 

[h3][b]5. Material Storage will be added[/b][/h3]
- “Material Storage” tab will be added to Storage, so that materials can be stored separately.
 
 

[h1][b][Revision Update of Current Content][/b][/h1]
 
[h3][b]1. There will be changes in Blessings of each class. Check out the details below.[/b][/h3]
 
[h3][b][Crusader][/b][/h3]
- Gift of Valor: Charge-type skills will be removed and effects related to Charge-type skills will be changed to Strike-type skills.
- Mark of the Wolf: The damage of Excess Bleeding will be increased as well as Bleeding.
- The Lionheart: The damage of Shout-type skills will be increased.
 

[h3][b][Ranger][/b][/h3]
- Gift of Valor: The damage of Tempest Shot will be increased, and Flashing effect will be stacked faster.
- Mark of the Wolf: Having a special arrow will give more power.
- The Lionheart: Scarred effect will be enhanced to give more damage to enemies.
 

[h3][b][Berserker][/b][/h3]
- The Lionheart: When using Shock attacks and Slash attacks, the duration will be increased to maintain stacking with more time.
- The Crescent Moon: Overall improvement will come to let players experience a new combat style after the update on October 28th.
 

[h3][b][Mage][/b][/h3]
- Gift of Valor: Charging effect will be applied to Frost-type skills, and a mechanism where Arcane-type skills can be used more often will be added to use Ice Breaking often.
- The Lionheart: The increased damage by Chain Explosion and Madness of Fire will be enhanced.
- The Crescent Moon: The skill enhanced while the Detection effect is applied will be able to be used more often.
 

[h3][b][Priest][/b][/h3]
- Gift of Valor: Increase of Critical Hit Damage will be added to Trance.
- The Lionheart: The damage will be increased to be faster and more aggressive during a Party play.
- The Crescent Moon: Overall improvement will come to let players experience a new combat style after the update on October 28th.

 
[h3][b]2. The drop rate of S items will be increased and their options will be adjusted.[/b][/h3][olist]
[*] The drop rate of S items will be increased by double from the current rate.
[*] The options of S(S+) items will be adjusted.
- Bound to character when obtained.
- Requires a new unbinding item. (The item will be available from the update on November)
   ㄴ “Unbinding Scroll” can be used for unbinding A or lower rank equipment.
- Cannot be stored in Account Storage (Can be stored after unbound)
- Bound to character if equipped after unbound.

[*] The required materials for the “Runes Adjustment” content from the future update can be obtained from salvaging S, S+ items.[/olist]
 
[u][b]* Binding Conditions for S Equipment before Patch[/b][/u]   
- The following binding conditions will apply to the S equipment obtained before the patch.
     
[b]Case 1.  If a bound item is stored in the Account Storage,[/b]
: It will be bound to the first character that retrieves the item after the patch.
      
[b]Case 2. For the equipment under an unbound state,[/b]
: The unbound state will still be maintained after the patch, and the equipment will be tradable and be able to be stored in the Account Storage.

[b]▶ Dev Comment[/b]
Many of S-tier items, the highest tier equipment, are currently obtained from trading not farming. We confirmed that players are losing their motivation for growth because of the high market price of Star Seed. By this, our goal is that players will be able to easily obtain the desired items from a direct game play by lowering the obtaining difficulty compared to before.
 
 
[h3][b]3. Enhancement Rate and Bonus Success Rate will be adjusted.[/b][/h3][olist]
[*] The enhancement success rate will be 100% up to the Rare grade, and the success rate will be increased for Epic, Legendary and up to Mythic +2.
[*] Bonus Success Rate of “Common Enhancement” and “Unlicensed Enhancement” will be automatically applied by grade, and the bonus rate will be lower in general.
[/olist]
 

[h3][b]4. Others[/b][/h3]
- The attendance reward will be changed. As the reward is changed, the attendance will be reset.
   ㄴ [b]Rescheduled to the November Update[/b] : Due to the change of the schedule, this will apply through the update next month. 
 
 
The details above are major changes and the final update details will be checked in the patch note on October 28th.
 
We are looking forward to your interest and support.
Thank you.

notes.title: Roadmap Q&A
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Adventurers,[/b]
 
We received a lot of questions in the global community since the “Bless Unleashed PC Update Roadmap (2021 - 2022)” announcement was posted.
 
To resolve your questions, we answered some major questions regarding the Roadmap.
Please see the details below.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/5a64aac5cfd63a58d2d5cfc6e6ddd3f94b4e05d7.jpg[/img]
[h1][b][Roadmap Q&A]
[/b][/h1]
[b]Q1. Are there plans for an update for new players?[/b]
: We are preparing support events and various systems for new players so they can enjoy the game together with existing players. There are also plans to continuously add new classes to 
recruit more new players.
 

[b]Q2. Updates for features that players consider high priority seem to be taking longer than expected. Will QoL/convenience improvements be made as soon as possible regardless of the roadmap schedule? [/b]
: The Roadmap only shows the development schedule of aspects that have already been decided. QoL/convenience improvements will continue to be made regardless of the Roadmap schedule.


[b]Q3. The Roadmap doesn’t seem to mention balance or class improvements. When will these changes occur? We also want to know if you are aware of the balance for close ranged classes in high-level dungeons.[/b]
: As mentioned in the Roadmap video, class balance patches are made with careful consideration. So we understand that news regarding such changes may seem frustratingly slow. A balance patch will be made in the upcoming update expected at the end of October. Further details will be shared in a later announcement.


[b]Q4. Most boss monsters’ attack patterns tend to be more hostile against close ranged classes. Are there plans to adjust the attack patterns of boss monsters?[/b]
: Close ranged classes have higher defense and HP than far ranged classes. Despite this, we received a lot of feedback and complaints from close ranged class players. We will apply your feedback for continued improvement.


[b]Q5. Can you provide details on the Assassin class? We want to know if the weapon used is a dagger or bow, as well as what skills are planned for the class. [/b]
: The new class, Assassin, uses a dagger as a main weapon and attacks secretly and quickly. It sometimes ambushes the enemy from behind or navigates between enemies to execute a wide ranged skill. We believe this class will be perfect for players who prefer stylish combat.
 

[b]Q6. Will it be possible to take points (XP, SP, etc) from a current character and apply it to the Assassin class instead when it is released?[/b]
: As the Assassin class is a new class, existing points cannot be shared between characters. Points must be newly obtained for the Assassin’s growth.
 

[b]Q7. Can the Assassin class update be made faster?[/b]
: Thank you for your interest in the release of the new class. We are doing our best to release the new class as soon as possible, but it will be difficult to have it available earlier than the announced date due to the development schedule.


[b]Q8. What is the standard used to determine the 1574 Gear Score of the Lv.40 Dungeons? Are there plans for adjustment?[/b]
: First of all, the Dungeon’s required Gear Score is determined based on the power of the Dungeon’s monsters. After the roadmap announcement, we reviewed player opinion on Gear Score from the community channels, and based on feedback that a Gear Score of 1574 is too high, the required Gear Score for Lv.40 Dungeons will be adjusted from 1574 to 1516.


[b]Q9. What else can you share with us about equipment from Lv.40 Dungeons?[/b]
: “S+” tier items can be obtained from Lv.40 Dungeons. “S+” tier items have the same base stats as “S” tier items, but have a better performance since it has one additional option.


[b]Q10. Why is the hurdle set so high for the new dungeons? Does this mean that the chances of acquiring good equipment are also higher?[/b]
: Players can obtain equipment with better performance than existing items from the Lv.40 Dungeons, which is why the required Gear Score is also higher than that of existing dungeons. Although the prep work required to enter the dungeons won’t be a walk in the park, players will be rewarded with corresponding powerful equipment. 


[b]Q11. Will the new Bless Breaths be obtained from the “Ancient Altar” or through fusion?[/b]
: We are currently discussing the ways for obtaining the new Bless Breaths. We will provide updates once it has been finalized through a later announcement.


[b]Q12. The names of new Blessings are visible in the Marketplace item list, so it seems like development is already complete.  Why is the update not performed right away?[/b]
: We believe that the names of new Blessings in the Marketplace are leftover traces from the transfer of the console to PC version. New Blessings for Bless Unleashed PC are still being developed.


[b]Q13. Can you provide more details on the Rune Adjustment system?[/b]
: A system where players can use a Regrant Card (official name TBD) obtained from in-game content to regrant an existing item’s Rune options is in the works. However, as this is a convenience system for reaching late game content, this system will only be available if you play up to the mid-late stages of the game.


[b]Q14. Can the Viewing Feature be updated earlier?[/b]
: We understand that in certain situations, players would like to see the information of other players. However, since convenience functions are updated in order, please understand that it would be difficult to change the existing schedule.


[b]Q15. Is a PvE and PvP preset feature for changing Blessings, skills and equipped items already being developed?[/b]
: We are currently developing a feature that allows players to easily switch between presets of skills, Blessings and equipment. This system will consume in-game currency for changing presets, and we aim to release it in January 2022.


[b]Q16. Why is the PVP Season starting when PvP has yet to be balanced?[/b]
: Class balance will be adjusted in the upcoming update, and a PvP balance patch will be among the modifications made. We are approaching the issue from multiple perspectives to create a fair competitive PvP environment, and expect battlefield content to be even more active after the October update.


[b]Q17. Will there be new Dungeon and Battlefield maps?[/b]
: We are continuously designing and creating new Dungeons and Battlefields. New maps that go well with the world of Bless Unleashed are being prepared, and will be released as soon as they’re ready. 


[b]Q18. This was not mentioned in the Roadmap, but are there plans for content/games that can be enjoyed within the Estate?[/b]
: We are aware of community suggestions on various Estate content such as fishing, gathering, and mining within the Estate. However nothing has been confirmed, and we are still working on ways to enhance Estate content.


[b]Q19. This was also not mentioned in the Roadmap, but is a PC exclusive UI being developed?[/b]
: PC friendly UI is continually being developed, however it does take some time from when development is complete until it is actually applied. Updates will be provide through future announcements.


[b]Q20. When will the 10-player Raid be released?[/b]
: It is currently being developed with a release goal in the first half of next year. The design consists of having 10 players working together to fight against giant boss monsters such as Elfirkraag (a new monster to be released soon.)


The upcoming October update will be made available through a patch on October 28th.
Please look forward to it!

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 30th (PDT)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,[/b][/h2]

A server patch was performed at around September 30th, 4:00PM (PDT) / October 1st, 1:00AM (CEST) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.



[h2][b]■ Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b][Marketplace][/b][/h3]
- Removed the required quest for the Marketplace.
- You will now see the description that says that Marketplace is accessible from Lv.27 when entering the Marketplace.
- Improved so that the listing fee of Marketplace will be returned when items are sold.
- When an item is sold, the listing fee will be returned via the Mail of selling item as an attachment.
- If multiple items are registered, the listing fee will be returned when all the items are sold.


[h3][b][PvP][/b][/h3]
- Increased the maximum amount of Victory Tokens from 30,000 to 300,000.
- Lowered the required Reputation level for purchasing equipment at Sen/Vos'Elan Equipment Merchant NPC.
- Changed the tier rank of the item from Sen/Vos'Elan Equipment Merchant NPC from B to A. Also, advanced the item options for A rank.
- For those players who previously purchased the equipment, they can exchange the used Victory Tokens at Sen/Vos'Elan Equipment Merchant NPC for one time only. The exchange is available by the next maintenance.

[h3][b][Quest][/b][/h3]
- Changed the quest objective of the Navarra Campaign quest, "In Service of the Crown", and the Blessing quest of “The Lionheart” from “Defeating the Harpy Queen” to “Defeating the trio near Navarran Military Camp”.
- Changed the quest objective of “Touch of Syrania 1” from “Splendid Alfonsino” to “Yellow Chromis”.
- Changed the quest objective of the Gnoll Wastes Campaign quest, “The Queen's Prophecy”, from “Defeating Gnoll in the Gnoll Triumvirate” to “Defeating the Stone Zephyr”.

[h3][b][Berserker][/b][/h3]

[b]■ Fixed Bug[/b]
- Fixed a bug where Berserker’s Charge skill cannot be used while the “Autocasting: Hold” is not activated.

[h3][b][Monster][/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the damage of some poison of Spider Queen and Twisted Void Spider Queen is not applied. Also, fixed so that the poison gives the proportional damage to the maximum HP and can break the Priest’s Protective Shield.
- Fixed a bug where after defeating Stone Zephyr, the sound still remains until the corpse disappears.

[h3][b][Costume][/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the bound setting is not displayed on the “Card: Vampire” costume item.
- Changed so that the “Card: Dreadnight Festival” costume item cannot be registered in the Marketplace.
  * If registered in the Marketplace before maintenance, it can be traded.

[h3][b][UI/UX][/b][/h3]
- Fixed the incorrectly applied effect of the 'Blossom Festival Tree' Lv.3 from “Production Speed Boost” to “Increases SXP Gain”.
- Improved so that the cooldown of rewards can be checked in the Dungeon list of the Matchmaking menu.

[h3][b][Others][/b][/h3]
- Fixed an issue where if a higher damage than the remaining HP of the target monster is inflicted while taming, only 1 HP remains.


We will continue to do our best in providing the best gameplay experience.
This announcement will be updated, or a new announcement will be made if additional updates are available.

Thank you.

notes.title: September 15th (PDT) - Actions Against Abnormal Transactions and Rewards
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,[/b][/h2]

We would like to provide an explanation and ask for your understanding of the following changes made by the September 15th (PDT) patch.
Lumena Shop items are no longer tradable through the Marketplace.
The required level to access the Marketplace has increased.

It was our aim to provide a variety of benefits and items at a reasonable, reduced price in our Lumena Shop, but unfortunately the system was being abused at an alarming rate by systematic operations of gold farmers. This meant that currency earned through illegal means was used in improper or illegal transactions via the Marketplace.

Not only has it affected the economy of the game, but it affected our average players as well.

In order to tackle this issue head on, our previous patch on Sept 2nd (PDT) applied a few changes to the Marketplace while aggressively implementing sanctions to accounts involved in such behaviors. While this was effective to a degree, it was short-termed. This situation has now reached the point where we are required to take an offensive approach. Thus, for the longevity and health of the game and our users, we inevitably decided to implement the recent changes to the game.

If these safety measures fail to mitigate the issue, the Marketplace may be closed off temporarily to all users to further tackle the issue.

A patch to improve the Marketplace is in progress, and we expect it to be effective against the abusive actions of the gold sellers. In line with the severity of the issue this will be our utmost priority.

In apology, we have prepared the following rewards.

[h3][b] ■ Rewards[/b][/h3]
- Schedule : Daily before the Marketplace system improvement patch takes place
- Reward: Bag Expansion Ticket x1  
- Delivery Method: Delivered through mail once per day upon initial login (once per account)
- Reward Delivery Schedule: 12AM (PDT)
Thank you, and we ask for your understanding of the situation.
We will continue our efforts in maintaining a strong and lasting game economy.

tags.balance_change: Lumena Shop items are no longer tradable through the Marketplace.
The required level to access the Marketplace has increased.

notes.title: September 15th (PDT) Update [Nightspire Dungeon & Twisted Void Spider Queen]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/3c88984e84697fd56687466dc4b4b35bf90f9970.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,
[/b][/h2]
We are excited to announce that Bless Unleashed PC’s first update is now live!

This update introduces the new Nightspire Dungeon and Field Boss, Twisted Void Spider Queen, providing a new challenge to even the strongest players. Employ a variety of action combat styles as you take on the diverse patterns of these formidable foes. 
It won’t be easy, but with allies you just might be able to beat it.

In addition to the update, a server patch was also applied in response to previously identified issues.


[h2][b]■ Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b][New Content][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/2b045a5e6589631f4143a9ecbf056ec1531f5609.png[/img]

[h3]1. New Field Boss “Twisted Void Spider Queen”[/h3]
[b]- Default Level : Lv. 42
- Location : Spider Cave north of Tristezza
[/b]
This new Twisted Field Boss brings different sets of challenge from your normal Spider Queen. Challenge this new Twisted Void Spider Queen and make sure to avoid her traps. This new Twisted Field boss have some new tricks up her sleeve, so make sure to keep your eye peeled, and guards up. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/6f0f74f667058f6cadf13d5d2dafef4445bb1d6a.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]2. New Time Dungeon “The Nightspire - Caverns of Wrath”[/b][/h3]
[b]- Required Level : Lv. 35
- Check in Dungeon > Time Dungeon.
- Schedule : Starts on the 38th Week (September 15th)[/b]

Hundreds of years ago, in the Dimensional Rift, a group of evil Savantis magicians were exiled and sealed due to their practice in forbidden magic, but Gideon, the descendant of the Savantis, recently broke the seal which takes form of a black tower, and this incident was named, the “Nightspire” incident.

There are three parts to the dungeon, “The Nightspire - Caverns of Wrath”. Similar to other dungeons, you will face, and challenge dungeon bosses placed in each parts of the dungeons. Team up with your allies and make sure to challenge these dungeon bosses.


[h3][b][Web Store][/b][/h3]
[b]■ Newly Added Products[/b]
- Premium Benefits (7 Days)
- Premium Benefits (30 Days)

[h3][b][Lumena Shop][/b][/h3]

[b]■ Cash Products not Tradable[/b]
- Products in Lumena Shop will become a non-tradable item, which cannot be registered in the Marketplace.

* Items purchased from Lumena Shop are bound to account..
* The Lumena Shop items already in possession cannot be registered in the Marketplace.
* The Lumena Shop items that were registered in the Marketplace before the September 15th maintenance can be purchased.

[b]■ Newly Added Products[/b]
- Card: Character Appearance Change
- Card: Character Hair Change
- Character Name Change Voucher
- Card: Novice Glasses
- Card: Novice Uniform

[b]■ Removed Products[/b]

[b] º  Package Product[/b]
[list]
- [Limited] Star Seed and Potential Blooming Package
- [Limited] Epic Costume Package
- [Limited] Bless Breath Special Package
- Bless Growth Package
 - Welcome Bless Fortification Package
- Star Seed Special Package
[/list]
[b] º  Functional Product[/b]
[list]
- Unbinding Scroll
[/list]

[b] º  Limited Product[/b]
[list]
- Unbinding Scroll
 - Unbinding Recharge Scroll
- Potion of Recovery II x 10
- Potion of Regeneration I x 10
[/list]

[b] º  Mileage Shop[/b]
[list]
- Healing Potion III
- Potion of Regeneration III
- Artifact Core Pouch
- Star Seed Box (Greater)
- Superior Panacea of Wellness
- Superior Panacea of Sharpness
- Superior Panacea of Destruction
- Superior Panacea of Blades
- Superior Panacea of Stoneskin
- Ember of Paetion (Legendary)
- Ember of Paetion (Mythic)
[/list]


[h3][b][Ancient Altar][/b][/h3]
- Changed so that drawing Superior Bless Breaths at the Ancient Altar will be available up to 30 times a day.


[h3][b][Crusader][/b][/h3]

[b]■ Fixed Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Crusader’s Guard is immediately cancelled if the Guard is used while using combos when “Auto-cast Hold Skills” is activated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong period was applied to the Bleeding effect that is activated when hitting enemies with “Zealot's Fire” of Crusader’s Mark of the Wolf.
[/list]


[h3][b][Berserker][/b][/h3]

[b]■ Fixed Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Berserker’s Shoulder Strike skill was not activated if one evades while using combo attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where Berserker’s “Eye of the Storm” is abnormally applied when using the “Rage” skill while the “Rushing Storm” effect of Gift of Valor is activated.
[/list]


[h3][b][Mage][/b][/h3]

[b]■ Blessings[/b]
- The Lionheart
[list]
[*] Madness of Fire
- Removed the vibration effect of camera when meteors fall by the “Madness of Fire” effect of Mage’s The Lionheart.
[/list]

[b]■ Fixed Bug[/b]
[list]

[/list]


[h3][b][Priest][/b][/h3]

[b]■ Fixed Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where combos were sometimes not triggered when Priest repeated evading and combos alternately.
[*] Fixed a bug where when keeping the hold of Priest’s class skill “Radiant Form”, auto-cast was not activated and it kept holding.
[*] Fixed a bug where Priest’s “Protection and Sacrifice” is not refreshed when “Shield of Faith” is refreshed while the “Shield of Faith” is activated.

[*] Changed so that players can use the Marketplace from Lv.27.
[*] * This limit is temporary to prevent abnormal trading and will be removed after the Marketplace is improved.
[*] 
[/list]

  - Armor Fortification Stone

[*] Fixed an issue where players get higher scores after clearing “The Nightspire - Entropic Descent” Dungeon due to the wrong computing standard for the rank.

In order to provide an enjoyable game experience to the adventurers who join us for the first update and the beginning of the new season of Bless Unleashed, we are giving the new Premium Bless Pass “Changing World” and Premium Benefits (7 Days) as a gift. Go receive them now if you didn’t yet.

Enter the world of Bless Unleashed right now and do not miss the chance to experience the new update.
Thank you.

notes.title: Bless Unleashed PC Official Live Stream Q&A Summary
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers, [/b][/h2]

Thank you for joining us for our official live stream last week held on September 10th, it was an amazing opportunity for us to communicate with our players.

For those who missed the stream or would like a refresher, the list of questions and corresponding answers are available below.


[u][h1][b][Live Q&A][/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[b][*] Ring of the Whispering Serpent God[/b]
 - For players who worked hard to put together the Ring of the Whispering Serpent God runes, we will aim to apply as soon as possible, a system that allows for runes to be re-rolled so players will have chances to switch runes. 

[b][*] Implementation of Skill Presets[/b]
 - The skill preset function is currently being developed, and will be revealed as soon as it is ready. 
 - As expected, players can set up skills and Blessings in advance so it can be changed right away. 

[b][*] Selling the Cosmetic Change Voucher in the Lumena Shop as a Standalone Product[/b]
 - Changes will be made so that it will be sold in the Lumena Shop.

[b][*] Berserker Class Bug Fixes [/b]
 - Bugs related to the Berserker’s Shoulder Slam and charging will be fixed with a patch in the near future.

[b][*] Blessing Convenience[/b]
- Changes are being made so that one combat Blessing and one Livelihood Blessing can be equipped at a time. 

[b][*] Jumping with the Ctrl Button [/b]
- Since evade is an important action in the game, it was assigned to the spacebar. Please note that it can be changed through key customization.

[b][*] Deal Meter (DPS Measurer)[/b]
 - There is no realtime deal meter.
 - However, since players need to be able to check Blessing mechanisms, we will prepare an instanced area for testing and monitoring one’s skills.

[b][*] Improving the Game Guide[/b]
 - We are aware that the game guide needs to be worked on. We will continue to perform improvements so that it will be a better resource for our players.

[b][*] Female Costumes for the Ippin[/b]
- In addition to male costumes, we are also developing female costumes, and will share it with our players once complete.

[b][*] Hiding Weapon Costumes[/b]
- We are working on a function for hiding weapon costumes.

[b][*] Dyeing Costumes[/b]
- The structure of dyeing equipment and dying costumes is different, making it difficult for us to take action quickly, however we will review this issue internally. 

[b][*] Marketplace Rigging [/b]
[*] - Discussions are ongoing with the developers about the marketplace. In addition to preventing real money trading, we will do our best to make sure that normal players will not be negatively affected through continuous patches.

[b][*] Race Change Voucher[/b]
- There are no plans for a Race Change Voucher. It is a difficult feature to implement because some races cannot be used with certain classes.

[b][*] Roadmap/ Content / New Class [/b]
- We plan to reveal our future roadmap sometime in September. More details will be available with the roadmap.

[b][*] Premium Benefits Standalone Product[/b]
- There has been feedback asking that Premium Benefits be sold as a standalone product. As a result we have been making the necessary preparations, and it will be purchasable beginning 9/16. 

[b][*] Maintenance Reward[/b]
- The current rewards were put together with the early days of release in mind. We will review ways to improve the rewards.

[b][*] Voiceovers[/b]
- Voiceovers for cutscenes and NPCs are being discussed within the dev team. We’ll provide updates once a decision has been made. 

[b][*] Ability to Skip Dungeon Videos[/b]
- The internal structure of videos in the dungeon makes it difficult to skip, however we will review the issue to see if it is skippable.

[b][*] Updating Fishing Content [/b]
- We plan to add a variety of fishing related quests as well as new fishes.

[b][*] Class Roles[/b]
- The roles of tanker, dealer, and healer are not strong in Bless Unleashed. Instead there are skills that can complement each class based on the character’s concept, which prevents gameplay that strongly focuses on class roles.

[b][*] Adjusting Minimal Dungeon Rewards[/b]
- We have taken note of feedback stating that dungeon rewards are boring, and are having internal discussions about increasing the rewards. 

[b][*] Attack Speed Weapon[/b]
- It won’t be available with S grade items, but we plan to add it to high difficulty dungeons later on. In addition to weapons, we are also planning accessories with the Attack Speed effect.

[b][*] Single Player Dungeon[/b]
[*] - Single player dungeon is currently in development. It will be something like an arena but fighting with monsters instead. We are thinking of utilizing a Time Attack system to allow players to compete with each other.

[b][*] PVP and Guild Content[/b]
 - Guild war content is being developed with the concept of it being in a field like space where multiple guild members have to capture a specific area.

[b][*] Collection System[/b]
- We do not have any plans for any collection type system, however discussions may proceed depending on player feedback. However our concern is that implementing a certain system will cause stress to our players.

[*] Unable to Search for Guilds
[*] - Being unable to search for guilds is a bug. We will fix this quickly.

[b][*] Class Balance[/b]
- Class balance changes made in the 9/8 PT patch are the first or many upcoming class balance patches.

[b][*] Barrier to Starting Estate Content[/b]
 - There are obstacles up until a specific level, but we’ll work to make estate content more accessible. 

[b][*] Duels[/b]
- This is currently being developed under the name of 1 vs.1 duels, and will be ready in an update soon. Players can think of it as a friendly 1vs1

[b][*] Battlefield Matchmaking and Rewards Upgrade[/b]
- PvP balance will be improved, rewards upgraded so that matchmaking is easier for battlefield content.

[b][*] Camera Sensitivity[/b]
- Preparations will be made so that sensitivity can be set for combat and non-combat mode.

[b][*] Nickname Change Voucher[/b]
 - A nickname change voucher is currently in the works, and we are planning to sell it on the Lumena Shop. 

[b][*] Costume Preview[/b]
-  Players can try on costumes in the Lumena Shop.

[b][*] Notoriety Abuse [/b]
-  We are looking into abuse involving Notoriety, and will perform updates to stop the abuse.

[b][*] Releasing a Santa Sleigh Mount for the Winter Season [/b]
- It won’t be a sleight mount, but a Roudolph mount is prepared.

[b][*] Player to Player Trading System[/b]
- A player to player trading system is not being considered due to the risks of issues such as real money trading.

[b][*] Marketplace Fee[/b]
[*] - The Marketplace fee can be reduced by using the Marketplace Discount Ticket. We think that the fee isn't too high when compared with other games. However, we will review this again based on your questions.

[b][*] Equipment Elemental Damage[/b]
- Elemental damage is additional damage that ignores the target’s defense. Some monsters have a specific elemental weakness, allowing even more damage to be dealt. 

[b][*] Skill Effect Improvements[/b]
- Due to the FX skill effect for each class being overdone, it is sometimes difficult to discern the monsters’ patterns. Continual improvements will be made to address this issue.

[b][*] 10-Player Raid Content[/b]
- 10-Player raid is in development, and will be updated once ready.

[*] Level Scaling Improvements
 - Level scaling for dungeons will continue to be worked on to alleviate the issue.

[b][*] Secondary Job System and New Class [/b]
- We do not have plans for a secondary job system at the moment, but expedite the release of a new class in the near future.

[b][*] Improvements to the Superior Bless Breaths Drawn with Lumena[/b]
 - Internal review will be performed to see if there are points for improving efficiency. 

[b][*] Union Skill[/b]
- There was some feedback regarding the Union skill that the increased aggro effect was not visible nor noticeable when used. This will be improved

[b][*] Addition of New Skills[/b]
 - New skills may be added when Blessings are also added. We have been continually developing Blessings, and will aim to apply it to the game quickly.

[*] Bag Stress
- We will look into providing an event-type bag product, or increasing the final bag space amount. 

[b][*] Showing your Character ID[/b]
- It is in development and will be applied once complete. 

[b][*] Salvaging Legendary Costumes[/b]
- This was blocked partially to prevent players from accidentally salvaging their legendary costumes by mistake, but we will review the issue to see if modifications can be made regarding convenience. 

[b][*] Feature for Unregistering Registered Costumes [/b]
- We are currently working on a feature that changes registered costumes into costume cards. We are preparing to make it so that unregistrating will generate a card item that can be sold on the Marketplace. 

[b][*] Preview Feature[/b]
- We are positively reviewing and will aim to develop a feature that allows players to examine the target’s equipment.

[b][*] Field Drop Rewards[/b]
- We are aware that rewards from the field are unsatisfactory. We intend to provide attractive rewards that will increase field enjoyment.

[*] Breath Fusion Convenience
- Improvements will be made for the convenience of Breath fusion by adding a feature that allows multiple fusion at once.

[b][*] Gender Change Voucher[/b]
- There are no plans for a Gender Change Voucher.

[b][*] Camera View Adjustment Convenience [/b]
- Development is underway to add the view zoom in/out feature while in photo mode.

[b][*] Improving Mount Movement Speed [/b]
- It is difficult to further increase the current mount’s sprint speed. However it seems possible to increase the amount of sprints for superior mounts. 

[b][*] Campaign [/b]
-  Problems with the campaign are being identified and the difficult parts will be improved to adjust the difficulty level.

[b][*] Same Class in a Party[/b]
- We will think about how we would like to proceed, and will let our players know of any changes.

[b][*] Dungeon Berserk[/b]
- This is an obstacle system for players who do not have a certain standard of equipment or aren’t able to understand the patterns. We ask for your understanding as the dungeon berserk system is content that is also present in the console version.

[b][*] Guild Depot[/b]
[*] - We plan to continuously improve the functional items in the Guild Depot.

[b][*] Class Bug [/b]
-  We are aware of most of the issues surrounding the classes. Fixes and patches are being quickly applied for cases that we can reproduce, while ones that cannot be reproduced are being investigated in detail. We will continue to look into the issues that cannot be resolved, so we ask for your patience and will provide good updates once possible.
[b]
[*] Can't Cancel the Berserker Relentless Cleave Skill after the Second Hit[/b]
- Since ‘Relentless Cleave’ provides high damage upon the 3rd hit when fully changed, it was intentionally set so that it doesn’t cancel in the middle. However, the skill can be canceled during the first hit, and depending on the circumstances, players may also choose whether to continue with the 2nd hit. If you are in a situation where you can’t use the skill to the end, we suggest cancelling after the first hit. 
-  We are looking into the issue where the Berserker hesitates for 1-2 seconds when Relentless Cleave is used at full charge and will fix the issue once it has been confirmed.

[b][*] Displaying Party Member HP Bars Above the Character[/b]
- We think that this is a necessary feature and have put in a development request.

[b][*] Berserker Blood Leech Skill[/b]
- The balance of Blood Leech in console was of extremely high efficiency, therefore allowing unlimited hunting. We will discuss more about the skill’s efficiency in the PC version.

[b][*] Obtaining Mana for Mages[/b]
- Modifications are being made to parts of the Mage’s mana to allow skills to be used well. 

[b][*] Restoring Items Through Support [/b]
- Support tickets are currently experiencing a delay, however we understand that item restoration is an important issue and will increase their priority. 

[b][*] Marketplace Fee[/b]
- The deposit currently cannot be returned. We will prepare to make changes.

[b][*] Auto-Run Feature for Controllers[/b]
 - Currently all buttons of the controller are used, but further discussions will be held to determine whether it will be implemented. 

[b][*] Class Balance and Bless Modifications[/b]
- We know that not all Blessings are currently balanced correctly. We will continue to update Blessings that have a low efficiency.

[b][*] Making Star Seed Shareable Account-Wide [/b]
- It will be difficult to make Star Seed shareable account-wide.

[b][*] Increasing Max Level and Adding New Regions [/b]
- There are no plans to increase the max level quickly. New regions will be added periodically. 

[*] [b]Obtaining the Elixir of Haste[/b]
- We will add more ways to obtain the Elixir of Haste when crafting is reformed.

[b][*] Priest Protective Shield UI [/b]
- In order to improve gameplay experience, we will fix an issue where when the Priest casts Protective Shield, the Protective Shield’s UI covers the HP bar. 

[b][*] Efficiency of Defense-related Accessories [/b]
- Currently defense-related accessories are not performing as designed baseline but players can expect to see the importance of the defense-related accessories in the new and upcoming dungeons in the future.

[b][*] Berserker Balance[/b]
- We think that instead of being over-balanced, the Berserker is demonstrating overall efficiency.

[b][*] Plans to Add the New Nightwind/ Blind Executioner Blessings[/b]
- These Blessings were available on the console version, but have been removed due to the Blessing system being reformed. Development is working to add them in the future.

[b][*] Increasing Field Rewards[/b]
- Named monsters are reset weekly due to the superior rewards given, however we will discuss increasing Field Boss rewards.

[b][*] Reentering Dungeons[/b]
- An issue where disconnecting while in a dungeon will not allow the player to reenter the dungeon has been identified internally as well, and is currently being fixed. We aim to apply this fix in the next update. 

[b][*] Loyalty[/b]
- We will further review the Loyalty rewards and provide updates once available.
[/list]


[u][h1][b][Responses to Previously Collected User Questions] [/b][/h1][/u]

[h2][b]■ Class / Balance[/b][/h2]

[h3]Q1. We are curious about the changes to the classes and balance improvements.[/h3]
- We want to start off by apologizing for the lack of preparation due to the many changes to the game after our Final CBT. Adjustments will be applied all across the board and it will be deployed periodically per content.This also includes PvP, crafting and Estate along with the class balance patch.

Currently, we have identified areas that will be further adjusted in regards to class balance, and our final goal is to remove any form of imbalance for each class. This also includes increasing the performance output of underperforming Blessing skills as well.

[h3]Q2. Are the devs aware of each class being fixated on one specific Blessing? What can we expect in the future?[/h3]

The imbalance between Blessing skills is something we are very much aware of and will be making constant adjustments to maintain a delicate balance. As mentioned briefly, under-performing Blessings and skills will receive an upgrade to meet the standard of other skills. We do not have any plans of adding Mythic grade Blessings at this time, but once it has been confirmed, our playerbase will be notified in advance.

[h3]Q3. Actual damage output and the visible damage for certain class skills seem to differ. Is this intended? Also how does defense penetration work in Bless Unleashed?[/h3]

The Penetration effect is effective against monsters with high defense in PvE, but it was actually a stat meant for PvP. I’m sorry to say, but we weren’t able to completely focus on PvP when we were still in the preparation stages. However defense will be very important once PvP balance is normally applied later on, therefore you can think of this as a counter option to be used for facing players with high defense. 


[u][h2][b]■ PVP[/b][/h2][/u]

 Q1. Any reasoning to partake in PvP content and plans to add a PvP related skill-set system?
The next patch will adjust the current PvP balance, and with the upcoming PvP season, season exclusive rewards will be added. Also balance will constantly be adjusted before the official start of the season for overall class balance and fairness. Regarding the skill set system, it is currently being developed and players can expect to see it in a future update.


[h2][b]■ Regarding Dungeon(s) [/b][/h2]

 Q1. Other than the recently revealed Nightspire dungeon, are there any plans on releasing new dungeons?
 A1. Yes, new dungeons designed for Time Dungeons Lv.35 are currently being developed. In the near future, a higher level Time Dungeon is also being designed. Players can also expect to see dungeons that they can adjust the levels to. This ties in with the various new equipment and rewards that can be obtained from the new upcoming dungeons.

 Q2. When facing a Dungeon Boss, and a player is locked out due to the closed entrance, the only way to participate with all of the team members is to revive back from the Soulpyre. Will this current system be maintained or can we expect some changes in the future? Also, any plans on a 2 - 4 man team being able to enter the dungeons?

To answer the first question, the reason for the current system is that an issue can occur if a revived player is able to immediately re-engage in the boss fights. That being said, we are looking into ways for players to re-engage or enter the dungeon boss fight if they are left out due to the current system.

As for the 5 player dungeon, discussions on developing a system to allow 2-4 man parties to enter a 5 player dungeon are also being discussed.
 
 Q3. This is regarding the level-scaling system. For example, a Level 35 player is comparatively more advantaged than a level 45 player in the Time Dungeon. What are the dev’s thoughts on this system?

This sort of frustration is completely understandable. 
The initial application for the system was on the basis that as the player’s level increased, so would the equipment equipped to the character. But as mentioned earlier, reducing the difficulty that scales with the level-scaling system, along with the dungeon level adjustment feature, will drastically reduce game-progression fatigue. Once the system settles in, removing the level-scaling system itself will be under review.




[u][h2][b]■ The status of further UI/UX Improvement[/b][/h2][/u]

1. The development for PC-optimized UI is currently underway. Due to the size of the development, 
secondary improvements will be applied to improve the current UI’s for better accessibility.

2. With the recent patch, the number of visible chats in the chat box has increased, but it can be adjusted based on the user’s preference. Ultimately, an overhaul of the
chatbox UI/UX is underway, and as stated above, smaller, secondary QoL changes will be applied in the future patches.

3. In the case of the Marketplace, many of our players have expressed their opinions on the difficulty with navigating through the Marketplace. Features such as a search function are currently in development and other options are being thoroughly reviewed.


[u][h2][b]■ System[/b][/h2][/u]

Q1. Why can’t all of the game content share a single reset time? (Ancient Altar, Limited Shop, Field Bosses, etc)

This is something we are very well aware of, and previously, almost of all our content shared a single
reset time. However there was a side-effect where it would cause a great amount of stress to the server which caused other issues to the game. But, we will make the appropriate adjustments so that content that shares similar traits will share the same reset time as well.

Q2. There are some frustrations regarding Dungeon matchmaking. Are there any ways to encourage players to actively participate in dungeon matchmaking? This also ties with creating parties, what are the dev’s thoughts on this matter?

We are considering ways to provide additional rewards to dungeons that are less frequently queued.
In addition, requesting or setting up a party through chat seems to be very inconvenient. The studio is discussing ways that are user friendly, and suitable for easier party making.

Q3. Improvements to Crafting

In the case of Crafting, it was not fully supported due to the adjustment that increased level-up speed that was applied at the launch of the game. This created an unintentional wall that our players have to overcome in order to experience the crafting content. (e.g The required amount to craft, and the ingredients needed.)  This will be actively reviewed to provide easier access to the content.



[u][b]■ Customer Support/Service[/b][/u]

[h3]Q1. Are the Live Operations team aware of the trending in-game/community issue(s)?[/h3]

Our days start with each region’s operation team monitoring and acquiring respective in-game and community reports for their respective regions. This is especially important the day of and after a patch has been released.

Not only our Live Operations team, but the devs are also paying close attention to community trends and user feedback, both of which are discussed on a regular basis so we can identify and determine the appropriate course of action and response.


[h3]Q2. Customer Support / Ticket Delays
[/h3]
On behalf of the Live Operations team, we apologize for the delayed response to our user’s inquiries through our customer support center.

Being a global service game, we have dedicated CS personnels for specific regions, and even though we have deployed many CS agents it has been proven difficult to reply back to all of the inquiries in a satisfactory standard that our players expect. This is also connected to gold farmers, chatting bans and use of illegal software. This led to many of our Live Operation personnels being on dedicated 24 hour response teams focusing on the above topics until the appropriate sanction systems have been deployed. This certainly had some effect on our responsiveness to user inquiries.

As a result, internal changes are being made to prevent further delay in customer support. The deployment of additional personnel and manpower to effectively provide support to our players are in progress. Once again, we apologize for the delay.


[h3]Q3. What are the course of actions to counter and prevent the use of Illegal programs and Hhcks?[/h3]

Before executing a sanction, three critical procedures are conducted.
First, detecting and analyzing the process on how the illegal programs/hacks function.
Second, deploying safety and prevention measures that essentially breaks the fundamental process of these programs.
Lastly, based on data and game logs, the Live Operations team will do a comprehensive sweep and track down users via a confidential investigation process and apply the necessary sanctions based on our operation policies. 

[h3]Q4. What about RMT(Real Money Trading)?[/h3]

We are fully aware of the RMT operations and transactions going on within the game.
From our investigation, almost all of the accounts that obtained any in-game items through fraud/chargebacks and any forms of abnormal payment transactions are somehow connected to gold farmers and RMT transactions.

Thus, accounts with abnormal payment transactions (Fraud, Chargebacks, excessive refunds, etc) are restricted until thorough investigation has been conducted. Based on our findings, if the account is deemed to partake in RMT transactions, all items associated with the transactions will be removed. The recent changes to the Marketplace are part of the safety feature to prevent RMT operations. Further features are being developed and will be deployed to further combat real money trading operations and gold farmers.


[u][h2][b]■ Promotions/Platform[/b][/h2][/u]

[h3]Q1. Many of our users and community are requesting further marketing and advertisement for the game. Any thoughts on this topic?[/h3]

Being that Bless Unleashed is serviced globally, many of our ongoing marketing campaigns are being focused on the major regions and countries.

Our marketing campaigns differ from region to region but overall, we are partaking in popular regional game shows and popular media outlets as well as partnering with streamers/influencers. Not to mention we also coordinate with Steam to increase our platform exposure.


[h3]Q2. Any plans in expanding platform service in the future?[/h3]
While platform expansion is currently being reviewed, our highest priority is focusing on Steam and providing a stable service to our players. Once the service has taken root  and is stable, platform expansion will be a part of our strategy in bringing in new and returning players.


Lastly, the live stream was a great opportunity to communicate directly to our players base and briefly outline some of the updates and changes that our players have been anxious to hear about. We promise to maintain an open, and clear line of communication with our players and try our utmost best to make improvements and changes that our players have been requesting for.

We appreciate everyone for their valuable time and feedback.

Thank you.

[b]Bless Unleashed PC Team.[/b]
