notes.title: Patch Notes - September 8th (PDT)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,
[/b][/h2]
A server patch was performed at around September 8th, 6PM (PDT) / September 9th, 3AM (CEST) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.



[h2][b]■ Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[u][h3][b][Crusader][/b][/h3][/u]
[h3]■ Class Skills[/h3]
[b]- Zealot's Fire[/b]
: “Zealot's Fire” can be disabled if using the skill while it’s activated.

[h3]■ Blessings[/h3]
[b]1) Mark of the Wolf[/b]
[b]- Fang of the Wolf[/b]
: Increased the max. stack limit of “Bleeding” from 3 times to 8 times.
: Decreased the damage per stack by 25%.

[b]- Razor Claw[/b]
: Increased the chance to inflict “Bleeding” while “Zealot's Fire” is active from 15~56% to 35~85%.
: Removed the effect where “Chains of War” causes “Bleeding” by a certain rate. Instead, if inflicting a damage with “Zealot's Fire” to a target with a certain amount of stacks of “Bleeding”, a new bleeding effect “Excess Bleeding” will be applied. The required amount of stacks is decreased according to the growth of “Razor Claw”.

[b]2) The Lionheart[/b]
[b]- Roar of the Lion[/b]
: Increased the damage of Shout skill from 100~250% of Attack Power to 160~320% of Attack Power.
- Shout
: Increased the damage bonus of Roar, Great Sweeping Slash, Spinning Slash from 20~75% to 20~120%.

[b]- Overwhelming Defense[/b]
: The effect can also be triggered when Counterattack skill is used as well as when Shield Block is used.

[h3]■ Fixed Bug[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the class skill “Righteous Vigor” effect is not activated even on Critical Hit.


[u][h3][b][Berserker][/b][/h3][/u]
[h3]■ Blessings[/h3]

[b]1) Gift of Valor
- Blade Wind[/b]
: Successful hit with Whirlwind skill applies the “Blade Wind” effect to yourself by the same rate as “Bleeding”. “Blade Wind” effect lasts for 20 seconds and can be stacked up to 10 times. Each stack increases the damage of “Whirlwind” by 6.5%.

[b]- Rushing Storm[/b]
: Upgraded the mx. stack limit of “Rushing Storm” from 10 times to 1~10 times.
: Added an effect where successful hit with combos reduces the cooldown of “Whirlwind” by a certain rate.

[b]- Eye of the Storm[/b]
: Added an effect where the cooldown of “Whirlwind” is reset and “Blade Wind” and “Rushing Storm” are applied when using “Rage”.


[u][h3][b][Ranger][/b][/h3][/u]
[h3]■ Blessings[/h3]

[b]1) Gift of Valor[/b]
[b]- Ramming Arrow[/b]
: Changed so that the arrow cost is decreased for Rush-type and Double Shot-type skills not only for “Tempest Shot”.

[b]- Sharpshooter[/b]
: Changed so that the Flashing effect can be refreshed even when the effect is stacked to the max. limit.
: Increased the duration of Flashing effect from 10~50 seconds to 20~90 seconds.

[b]- Neural Stimulation[/b]
: Changed the effect where Tempest Shot is additionally charged 1 time, so that it’s additionally charged up to 2 times.
: Improved the issue where combos are not triggered when used consecutively. However, this is only applied to the attacks of 0.3 seconds or above, and the improvement for the attacks of below 0.3 seconds will be applied through the future update.

[b]2) The Lionheart[/b]
[b]- Threat of the Beast[/b]
: Increased the max. stack limit of “Scarred” from 3 times to 5 times.
: Decreased the effect of “Scarred” per stack by 20%.
: Increased the duration of “Scarred” from 5~25 seconds to 7~25 seconds.
: Fixed a bug where “Scarred” was applied to a single target even used to multiple targets at once.

[b]- Encouragement[/b]
: Changed so that the Attack Power Reduction effect is activated when “Scarred” is stacked to the max. limit.
: Added an effect where the cooldown of “Bottomless Quiver” is reduced by a certain rate when attacking a target with max. stacks of “Scarred”.

[b]- Sharp Claws[/b]
: Increased the chance to additionally cause “Scarred” from 10% to 10~30%.

[h3]■ Fixed Bug[/h3]
-Fixed the description of “Neural Stimulation” of Ranger’s “Gift of Valor” Blessing that states the cooldown of Tempest Shot is reduced by 1 second. Edited from 1 second to 2 seconds, and the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds as before.


[u][h3][b][Mage][/b][/h3][/u]
[h3]■ Blessings[/h3]

[b]1) The Lionheart
- Chain Explosion[/b]
: Increased the default duration of “Chain Explosion” from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.
: Added an effect that increases the damage of “Meteor”.

[b]- Madness of Fire[/b]
: Increased the default duration of “Madness of Fire” from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.
: Increased the number of meteors dropped by using “Flame Wave” while “Madness of Fire” is active from 1 to 1~3. 1 meteor at stage 1 of Flame Wave, 2 meteors at stage 2, 3 meteors at stage 3 are dropped.
: Additional 3 meteors are dropped if using “Meteor” while “Madness of Fire” is active.

[b]- Boost Firepower[/b]
: Changed the effect of Mana cost reduction from reduction by 100% at Lv.10 to reduction by 100% at Lv.5.
: Add an effect that increases the damage of Flame combos by 50~150%.

[b]- Heart of Fire[/b]
: Changed the effect of Mana cost reduction of Flame combos and skills from reduction by 10~40% to reduction by 20~60%.

[b]2) The Crescent Moon[/b]
[b]- Chosen by Arcane[/b]
: Increased the duration of “Chosen by Arcane” from 7~20 seconds 12~30 seconds.

[b]- Chosen by Flame[/b]
: Increased the duration of “Chosen by Flame” from 7~20 seconds 12~30 seconds.

[b]- Elemental Detection[/b]
: Increased the duration of “Flame Detection” and “Arcane Detection” from 10 seconds 20 seconds.

[h3]■ Fixed Bug[/h3]
: Fixed a bug where Mage can go through the wall using the “Blinkstrike” skill in some Dungeons.


[u][h3][b][Priest][/b][/h3][/u]
[h3]■ Blessings[/h3]

[b]1) The Lionheart
- Benediction[/b]
: Added an effect that increases the healing amount of Healing Sphere created through Benediction by 20~150%.

[b]- Fervor[/b]
: Added an effect increases the attack power by 4% per stack.

[b]2) The Crescent Moon
- Overflow[/b]
: Decreased the max. stack limit of “Overflow” from 10 times to 5 times.
: As the max. stack limit is decreased, the effect per stack increased by double.

[b]- Eruption[/b]
- Decreased the max. stack limit of “Eruption” from 30 times to 10 times.
- As the max. stack limit is decreased, the effect per stack increased by 3 times.

[h3]■ Fixed Bug[/h3]
- Fixed so that although Priest receives “Shield of Faith” from another player while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is active, “Protection and Sacrifice” effect is properly applied.
- Fixed an issue where Priest’s “Retribution” skill is fired into the air when using it to the monsters around after completing gathering or mining.


[h3][b][Quest][/b][/h3]
- Change the conditions for the Invasion quest of Kannus Mountains, “Creatures of Chaos” to completing “The Cursed Mountain” Crusade quest once and interacting with Suspicious Altar.
- Changed so that “Defeat Bashal” and “Defeat the Harpy Queen” during the class level quest “The Master's Test” can be also completed by defeating a Twisted Boss.


[h3][b][Dungeon][/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug where after defeating the first boss “Malignis” in the Time Dungeon “The Nightspire - Entropic Descent”, characters cannot move properly on the bridge that appears after activating a Soul Pyre in the second location.
- Changed so that the “Bloodclot” skill of “Plague Titan”, the boss of the Time Dungeon “Forgotten Sewers”, will be removed when the boss is defeated.
- Fixed an issue where the damage of Bleeding effect caused by the attack from “Vasilios”, the boss in the Time Dungeon “[Abyssal] Savantis Mausoleum - Altar of Blood”, is abnormally low.


[h3][b][UI/UX][/b][/h3]
- Removed the unused rewards list button from the Reputation Menu.
- Fixed an issue where Livelihood Blessings are shown under “Combat Blessings” in the Blessings Menu.
- Fixed a bug where Mails are not shown when it becomes the combat mode while Mailbox is opened.
- Improved so that more characters can be displayed on the disabled chat window.
- Fixed a bug where the available mark for taming did not disappear even after completing the Taming quest.

[h3][b][Item][/b][/h3]
- 20 second cooldown is applied to the effect of “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God”. Blood Leech effect is activated again after the cooldown period once it’s activated.


[h3][b][Others][/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug where when players are resurrected at the Soul Pyre in Kannus Mountains: Herbati Scout Camp, the players are damaged by being resurrected in the air.
- Fixed a bug where when players are resurrected at the Soul Pyre in Navarran Military Camp, the players immediately die upon resurrection by the damage from a fall.
- Fixed an issue where remaining time for item registration was not displayed properly on the “Retrieve” tab in Marketplace
- Fixed an abnormal motion when jumping in the water after falling into the water from a high position.
- Fixed a bug where when it’s refreshed to a new worker when a worker respawns in the Tavern of Estate, the worker list of the Tavern is not matched.
- Fixed some possible causes that can make Attendance not work properly.
- Fixed an issue where it was able to chat with restricted language using a chat macro.
- Changed so that all servers in the ASIA region are now under integrated Matchmaking.
   * Servers:  Baraka, Syrania, Iraphos, Ash’Luha, Kuat Ran


[h2][b][Dev’s Comment][/b][/h2]
[h3]▶ “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” Effect Adjustment[/h3]

As mentioned in the “Letter from PD Koven Park”, we have adjusted the effect of “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God”, one of the accessory items.

Although the “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” is a Rare grade item, its effect level has been unintentionally higher than the other rings with the same grade, as much as the higher grade items.
The need for the effect adjustment was internally mentioned, but it had to be examined thoroughly since many players are already using it.

We prioritized to provide a balanced game play by adjusting the effect of “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” deviated from the intended design, and unavoidably decided to lower the level of the effect.

We hope you understand this unavoidable adjustment for the entire game balance.

The biggest worry and concern from this long decision was that the players who already have the “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” might think the adjustment would be unreasonable for them.

We are going to maximize the rewards to the players with “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” without affecting the game economy.
We ask those players for a kind understanding.


[h3][b]■ Details[/b][/h3]
[b]- Adjusted Effect[/b]
: Blood Leech effect is activated again after 20 seconds(cooldown) from the previous activation.

[b]-Rewards Details[/b]
: “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” can be exchanged for a certain amount of Star Seed at “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God Collector” NPC during the exchange period.

[b]- Exchange Period[/b]
:September 8th ~ Before September 15th maintenance.

[b]- How to Exchange[/b]
: Exchange at “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God Collector” NPC located in Sperios, Carzacor, Navarra, Gnoll Wastes and Tristezza.

[b]- Exchange Price[/b]
: The amount of Star Seed will be arranged as long as it doesn’t affect the game economy and quotations.

[b]- Only 1 exchange is available per Character[/b]


[b][Notes][/b]
- The exchange must be done within the exchange period mentioned above.
- “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” cannot be newly obtained during the exchange period.
- It can be obtained again after the update upon the end of the exchange period.
- Limit of obtaining the “Ring of the Whispering Serpent God” is to minimize Star Seed inflation that can be caused by exchanging the item to Star Seed.


In addition, we are preparing so that players will obtain an array of useful accessories as mentioned in the “Letter from PD Koven Park”. We will be back soon to let you enjoy the new farming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/dfa488b20d78e7edc72c4c5190edf3ca6a9de88c.png[/img]

We will continue to do our best in providing the best gameplay experience.
This announcement will be updated, or a new announcement will be made if additional updates are available.

Thank you.

notes.title: A Letter to the Bless Unleashed PC Community from PD Koven Park (Part 2)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,[/b][/h2]

I would like to dive a little deeper in the direction where the studio is headed as I mentioned in part 1 of my letter.


[h3][b]First, UI/UX improvements are being made and will be announced in detail through  our future roadmap.[/b][/h3]
 
The studio is aware of the feedback given from our players regarding the current UI/UX system being not so PC friendly. Thus we recognize that further improvements are needed to the existing system. 
 
Much of the feedback including the marketplace search function, keyboard and mouse interface, display of content information etc. are being thoroughly reviewed so we can create a more immersive gameplay experience. Please be aware that each and every piece of feedback is being investigated in our development team and will continue to be improved through future patches.

Details regarding the UI/UX improvements will be revealed through a future roadmap so players can fully understand what will be changed beforehand. 
 

[h3][b]Second, we will be strengthening both security and penalties regarding hackers and illegal programs.[/b][/h3]

[h3][Illegal Programs][/h3]
Abnormal content play using illegal programs has recently been increasing.
We have strengthened in-game monitoring and are restricting game play for accounts that have been confirmed to use illegal programs. We will do our best to eradicate the use of illegal programs by continually investigating and updating the game so players can enjoy a comfortable gameplay experience.


[h3][Real Money Trading Advertisements] [/h3]
We are currently actively monitoring and restricting players advertising real money trading.
However, because these players constantly create different patterns to advertise, we will and are continuing to strengthen our internal filtering system as well as building automatic restriction systems in response to developments on this issue. 

[h3][Abnormal Transactions + Starseed Real Money Trading][/h3]
Players abusing payment related chargebacks, fraud, or unpaid card fines are now automatically restricted by our integrated detection systems. In addition, we have been tracking, collecting and restricting users who have been using the in-game marketplace to move Star Seed as a part of abnormal transactions by selling a usually low cost item at an unusually high price.


The Round 8 Studio team promises  to do their best to eradicate illegal programs and users participating in illegal transactions continuously.  


[h3][b]Third, our focus is on improving class and content balance.[/b][/h3]

The development team is aware of the issues surrounding balance, and have been reviewing and testing all feedback received from our users. In order to build a strong and lasting game balance, we are being extremely careful when it comes to adjusting the performance of characters, Blessings, and items. 

Currently, we are refraining from applying any sudden balance reduction updates to prevent our players from feeling a sense of loss. However, modifications cannot be avoided in the case of gameplay bugs, where content overwhelms the players unintentionally, and when content is not functioning as designed. It may be a disappointing update for some players, but we ask for your understanding that it is a necessary adjustment to allow more players to enjoy the game. 

We recognize that there are some issues such as how certain Blessings have comparatively low efficiency or are not as usable mechanism-wise, as well as issues where the content was made too easy to complete.

We plan to employ the following direction in balance updates that will be made to address these issues.


[h2][b][Crusader] [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Crusader - Mark of the Wolf
- The concept of continuous damage for the Crusader Mark of the Wolf will be strengthened. 
- The ratio of damage from Bleeding as well as the max stackable amount of Bleeding will be increased. The Crusader’s position as a durational damage specialist will be enhanced through changes such as the effect being changed to Excess Bleeding if another skill is used when Bleeding is stacked. 

[*] Crusader - Lionheart Legacy
- The Crusader’s Lionheart Legacy provides both buffs and damage when using Shout skills. Changes prepared for the Lionheart Legacy are expected to increase overall attack ability. Damage will be increased for when Shout skills are used due to Roar of the Lion, and combo damage from the shout effect will also be increased to output an amount of damage equal to the complexity of the Blessing’s controls.
[/list]

For The Crescent Moon, changes such as increasing the duration of the defensive stance for the core skill ‘Counterattack’ so that enemy attacks can be blocked easier are currently being made to make it easier to manage.


[h2][b][MAGE] [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Mage - Lionheart Legacy
- The Mage’s Lionheart Legacy class specializes in Flame-type combos and skills.
- Due to the large amount of mana consumption for Flame-type combos, by the time the Chain Explosion effect is activated, the lack of mana prevents the user from using additional skills when needed. This is currently being addressed to give the Mage class more flexibility in their skill usage. Also, the issue where the Chain Explosion effect did not apply to Meteor skill will also be fixed to offer a more fluid skill effect application. We will also make adjustments to the effect of Madness of Fire, by making changes to the damage radius and other changes to the small meteor when Flame Wave is used.

[*] Mage - The Crescent Moon
- It has proven to be difficult to maintain the selection between Flame-type and Arcane-type skills. And to quickly address the concern, the effect durations for each skill will be increased for an easier, and fluid skill management.
[/list]

In the case of the Mage class, the studio is aware of the biggest concern of the constant lack of mana.
And the devs are constantly reviewing a suitable balance for the class and we hope our players can expect some great changes coming their way.

[h2][b][RANGER] [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Ranger - Gift of Valor
- We are ready to upgrade the core effect for Gift of Valor, ‘Flash’. Players can expect the increased duration of the ‘Flashing’ effect as well the effect duration reset when the same effect is applied while the other is still in effect.


[*] Ranger - Lionheart Legacy
- Upgrade to the ‘Scarred’ debuff effect to bring more out of the team synergy.
- The max stack will be increased and when ‘Bottomless Quiver’ is used while the effect is applied, additional ‘Scarred’ effect will be added at a certain rate which is a significant buff to the class.
- Also additional mechanics can be expected to be added to incentive the use of the ‘Bottomless Quiver’ skill. 
While the changes may not be so dynamic, the adjustments will change the Range class to be more suitable, and contribute more in teamplay scenarios.
[/list]


[h2][b][PRIEST] [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Priest - Lionheart Legacy
[*] In terms of the Priest’s blessing, the system is designed so that the class will recovery HP through damage output and in the case of the Lionheart Legacy, ‘Benediction’ is the prime example. Adn with the upcoming balance changes, the effects of the Healing Orbs increase when the skill is upgraded.
[*] Also, the ‘Fervor’ effect, in addition to the increased attack speed, it also applies increased attack damage effect to allow the class to be more aggressive then the current meta.

[*] Priest - The Crescent Moon
- The process leading up to the activation core mechanics of the Blessing, and applying the effects is arduous and difficult to master in the current design. Adjustments to the Divine Strike, and Eruptions skill will be made for easier class control.

[*] Priest - Mark of the Wolf
- This particular Blessing is regularly being reviewed for its efficiency. ‘Protection and Sacrifice’ skill contains effects that increase attack damage and recovers HP and is considered a high-performing skill but the studio’s core direction is that the Blessings itself are designed to be suitable and optimized for certain scenarios/contents in the game. Thus currently under review. If the recovery effect have higher performance output from other HP recovery skill effects, necessary adjustments will be made, after a thorough internal testing and feedback from our players.
[/list]


[h2][b][BERSERKER] [/b][/h2]
In the case of the Berserker class, and the data gathered, indicators show that based on the number of Berserker class and the selection of the available Blessings, the blessing selection is geared towards one specific Blessing. 

This does not necessary mean that the balance between the Berserker class and the available Blessings are not in tuned, but instead that regardless of the selection of the Blessing, the combination between ‘Rage’ and ‘Guillotine’ is too overpowered which makes the selection of Blessing meaningless. 

This balance is currently under review and as stated earlier, does not mean a nerf to the class. Similar to Gift of Valor, if the effects are directly tied to attack skills, adjustments such as buffing the skill, ‘Whirlwind’ is under consideration to have an alternative skill selection other than ‘Guillotine’. And in the cases where a skill is forced to be used similar to Crescent Moon’s Rage: Extinction, we are looking into options to change the mechanism of the Blessing as a whole. 

While the mentioned adjustments and changes are still in its early stages, as soon as the appropriate balance changes are made, our users will be informed of the final changes.

The studio is always continuously reviewing the balances between each class as well as other contents which are listed below.

[h2][b][Adjustment to the Invasion balance][/b][/h2]
Despite the extensive waiting time to participate in regional Invasions, the time it takes to complete the Invasions is very short. Thus, players that wish to participate in the Invasion content have a fairly short, and limited time window. And to mitigate the issue, a scaling system will be applied based on the number of participants in the Invasion that will adjust the monster’s HP. The appropriate balance changes will be applied first, and increasing the quality of the Invasion rewards are currently in review.


[h2][b][Dungeon & Reward Balance Adjustment][/b][/h2]
The Abyssal dungeons are currently set to have the highest difficulty level in the game. And also aware of the unrealistic condition to enter the dungeon thus implementing a system that will raise the current entry condition to the specific dungeons. Also internal balance adjustments to specific dungeons will be made, and in return, increase the dungeon clear compensation.

Also, players can expect to see some changes to the accessories that have been underperforming from the intended design and add new accessories that will provide additional utility in the future patches. Timed Dungeon compensations will drop an array of accessories that will be useful in many contents of the game. 


[h2][b][PVP Balance][/b][/h2]
PvP Balance will continuously be reviewed and adjusted based on the current state of the game.

The official PvP Season will start with the Fall update, and before the official start of the season, the following changes will be applied. 

To avoid battles that decide the winners and losers based on the character’s equipment, skills and stats, it will be adjusted to be geared more towards the player’s controls and expertise in the game.
This will include general adjustments to PvP balance and the PvP attack damage multipliers. And constantly review skills and effects in the content to maintain the right balance between all classes.



We understand that many of these upcoming changes may not be so welcoming to some of our players but many changes are not permanent and subject to change based on the data and importantly, feedback from our players.


All the changes that our players can expect to see will be made sequentially and thank all of our users for their patience and support for our game. We aim to offer high quality, immersive and in-depth game contents to our users, and hope to join us in the exciting journey that awaits.

tags.bug: Also, the issue where the Chain Explosion effect did not apply to Meteor skill will also be fixed to offer a more fluid skill effect application.

tags.balance_change: The ratio of damage from Bleeding as well as the max stackable amount of Bleeding will be increased.

Damage will be increased for when Shout skills are used due to Roar of the Lion, and combo damage from the shout effect will also be increased to output an amount of damage equal to the complexity of the Blessing’s controls.
We will also make adjustments to the effect of Madness of Fire, by making changes to the damage radius and other changes to the small meteor when Flame Wave is used.
And to quickly address the concern, the effect durations for each skill will be increased for an easier, and fluid skill management.
Players can expect the increased duration of the ‘Flashing’ effect as well the effect duration reset when the same effect is applied while the other is still in effect.
The max stack will be increased and when ‘Bottomless Quiver’ is used while the effect is applied, additional ‘Scarred’ effect will be added at a certain rate which is a significant buff to the class.
Adn with the upcoming balance changes, the effects of the Healing Orbs increase when the skill is upgraded.
Also, the ‘Fervor’ effect, in addition to the increased attack speed, it also applies increased attack damage effect to allow the class to be more aggressive then the current meta.
Adjustments to the Divine Strike, and Eruptions skill will be made for easier class control.
And to mitigate the issue, a scaling system will be applied based on the number of participants in the Invasion that will adjust the monster’s HP.
Also internal balance adjustments to specific dungeons will be made, and in return, increase the dungeon clear compensation.
This will include general adjustments to PvP balance and the PvP attack damage multipliers.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 2nd (PDT)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,[/b][/h2]

A server patch was performed around September 2nd, 6PM (PDT) / September 2nd, 3AM (CEST) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.



[h2][b]■ Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[b][Quest][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the objective of the “Touch of Syrania 2” quest was not updated in the description after the objective was changed from “Pinkspot Crimson Seabream” to “Cigar Wrasse”.
[*] As there was an issue where players couldn’t complete the Bone Dragon regional quest “Emeraxia's Lair” after defeating the Bone Dragon from outside the quest area, the quest area for completing the quest has been increased.
[*] Fixed so that remaining items after completing “Mix, Turn, and Mix Again!” quest can be destroyed in the Bag.
[*] Fixed the contribution ratio and rewards of Invasions Quests

[Contribution]
[*] Grade 1: (Before) Top 20% -> (After) Top 40%
[*] Grade 2: (Before) Top 60% -> (After) Top 50%
[*] Grade 3: (Before) Bottom 20% -> (After) Bottom 10%

[Rewards]
[*] Equipment rewards have been removed and ‘Artifact Core Box’ rewards have been added.
[*] Can acquire 1,000 / 500 / 200 Artifact Cores based on grade
[*] ‘Precision repair tool’ rewards have been added to Grade 1 and 2 rewards.
[*] Higher chance of obtaining in Grade 1 rewards
[*] ‘Ember of Paetion’ rewards have been added to Grade 1 and 2 rewards.
[*] Can obtain Mythic Paetions in Grade 1, Legendary Paetions in Grade 2
[*] Invasions Rewards will be changed in accordance with the change in contributions.

[b][Blessings][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage increase effect by Blessings were not properly applied to some skills that inflicts area damage on the ground. (Ex. Meteor)

[b][Crusader][/b]
[*] Crusader’s Counterattack skills break combos when it is used during combos. Fixed the skill description stating that “This skill does not break combos even when it is used during a combo.”.
[*] Fixed an issue where the statement that the Crusader’s “Dauntless Charge” skill can be used maximum 2 times in a row was missing in the skill description.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Brave Assault” effect of Crusader’s “Gift of Valor” Blessing was not activated when the Charge skill level was 20 or above.

[b][Berserker][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the statement that the Berserker’s “Charge” skill would get “Interrupt Immunity” effect when its level reaches 25 was missing in the skill description.
[*] Fixed an issue where the statement that the ‘movement speed reduction effect increases as the Berserker’s “Overpower” skill is upgraded’ was missing in the skill description.
[*] The stack of “Rushing Storm” of Berserker’s “Gift of Valor” Blessing is consumed when hitting enemies with Whirlwind. Fixed the skill description stating that the stack is consumed when Whirlwind is used.

[b][Ranger][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ranger’s “Natural Instincts” effect of “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing was not able to properly increase the damage of the “Thundering Arrows” skill.

[b][Mage][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the duration of Mage’s “Blizzard” skill was incorrectly increased when the “Frost Wolf” effect of “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing was increased.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Mana Conduit” effect can be applied even without equipping the Mage class skill “Concentrate”.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effect of “Mana Conduit” class skill was not properly refreshed when casting the skill within 30 seconds from the previous casting.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Autocasting: Hold” option was not applied to the Mage’s “Frost Armor” and “Concentrate” class skill.

[b][Priest][/b]
[*] Improved the issue where when the combos are continued, the “Benediction” effect of Priest’s “The Lionheart” Blessing can only be applied once.
[*] Fixed an issue where when the Priest’s skill is used right after the “Shield of Faith” is used while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is activated, a cooldown is sometimes applied to the skill.
[*] Fixed a bug where when the Priest’s “Shield of Faith” skill is used in the area of effect range, protective shield effect is sometimes not applied to a target if the target evades.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “unable to recover resource” icon among the “Protection and Sacrifice” effect of the Priest’s Mark of the Wolf Blessing is displayed to other allies who have received the “Shield of Faith” effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Autocasting: Hold” option was not applied to the Priest’s “Retribution” skill.

[b][Monster][/b]
[*] Lowered the XP gain amount for defeating “Undead Gladiator” in Carzacor.
[*] Applied HP scaling to the monsters appearing during Invasion quests according to the number of participants of the quest.
[*] Fixed so that planned items will be dropped in the planned location for crafting materials although field monsters’ level scaling is applied.
[*] Fixed an issue where Volcanic Wyvern / Thunder Wyvern / Stonescale Wyvern in Zenkala were  sometimes reset during combat after the monsters used a Charge skill.
[*] Decreased the reset range so that players cannot unilaterally attack the monsters from the place where they are not attacked using terrain features.

[b][UI/UX][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where an item couldn’t be selected due to the location of a tooltip in Estate Warehouse.
[*] Removed the Guild Depot’s “Empty” feature that removes all stocked items.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tooltip of selected Legend icon was not showing on the maximum zoom out.
[*] Fixed a bug where the final attendance reward was shown to be available to receive even after the final reward was received.
[*] Fixed an issue where related achievements and Bless Pass missions were not achieved when selling items using the ‘sell all’ function.
[*] Related achievements: Savvy Merchant, The Closer, My Bag of Gold, Common Marketplace VIP 
[*] Related Bless Pass missions: Earn gold from selling items (Reach 12,000 store sales gold)

[b][Marketplace][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where when players purchase Breath items in the Marketplace, the Breath item was not showing if using the class filter. The patch will not be applied to the items registered in the Marketplace before the patch but items registered after the patch.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Adept Blacksmith Nil Contract” item couldn’t be registered in the Marketplace.
[*] Changed so only the lowest 3 prices are shown in the sales list for items in the Marketplace. This does not apply to equipment items or costume cards.
[*] Changed so that when registering an item for sale on the Marketplace, it appears on the sales list only after a certain amount of time.

[b][Text][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where Lumena was not showing for Loyalty rewards with level 5, 8, 9, 10 in “Loyalty Information”.
[*] Added a description stating that a rare costume can be obtained through a fusion of some Legendary costumes at a probability.
[*] Fixed an issue where Legendary “Breath” items cannot be fused but the tooltip of Legendary “Breath” items says that they can be upgraded to a higher-grade Breath through a Fusion Specialist.
[*] Fixed an issue where the word “Void” was missing from the name of “Defeat the Twisted Boss” achievement in the Achievement menu.
[*]* Twisted Void Grasslands Giant, Twisted Void Harpy Queen, Twisted Void Bashal, Twisted Void Giant Cyclops

[b][Others][/b]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Fusion Specialist in Zenkala was spawned under the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue where the combat mode would sometimes not be cancelled after field combat.
[*] The Login Time Streak Reward for 90 Min has been changed from “Potion of Recovery II x 5” to “Potion of Recovery V x 3”.
[*] Fixed so that “Card: Explorer's Trusty Stallion” that can be obtained from attendance can be destroyed or sold to the Merchant.
[*] Fixed so that the effect of the following items that can be obtained from quests will not be cancelled upon logging out or death.

[*] [Quest] PvE Combat XP Booster (15 min)
[*] [Quest] PvE Combat XP Booster (30 min)
[*] [Quest] Gold Gain Booster (15 min)
[*] [Quest] Gold Gain Booster (30 min)
[*] [Quest] SXP Boost Ticket (15 min)
[*] [Quest] SXP Boost Ticket (30 min)
[*] [Quest] Bonus Gathering Ticket (15 min)
[*] [Quest] Bonus Gathering Ticket (30 min)
[*] [Quest] Additional Mining Ticket (15 min)
[*] [Quest] Additional Mining Ticket (30 min)
[*] [Quest] Additional Logging Ticket (15 min)
[*] [Quest] Additional Logging Ticket (30 min)
[/list]



We will do our best to provide a better environment for your game play.
Further updates will be provided through either this or another announcement.

Thank you.

notes.title: Restoration of Repeatedly Decreased Resurrection Currencies during Resurrection
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers, [/b][/h2]

We have found out [b]the issue where the resurrection currencies, ‘Gold’, ‘Star Seed’, and ‘Recovery Scroll’, were repeatedly decreased[/b] if players tried to be resurrected while a lag issue was occuring.

The recent lag issue that occurred during the Bone Dragon hunting has been improved through the patch on August 22nd and players now can play the hunting on a smooth server environment.

As this issue is not occuring anymore, we have restored the abnormally decreased currencies during the maintenance on August 25th.

As similar other cases occurred due to a lag were also found, [b]we considered the entire period from the start date of service for cases of restoration.[/b]

The details are as follows.

[list]
[*] Period of Restoration : August 6th 09:00 ~ August 25th 18:00 (PDT) 
[*] Restoration Case : If logs of repeated decrease on resurrection during the said period is confirmed.
[*] Restored Items : Currencies for resurrection (Gold, Star Seed, Recovery Scroll)
[*] Restoration Method : Providing through in-game Mail.
[*] Mail Title: Compensation for Abnormally Decreased Resurrection Currencies
[/list]

We will make efforts to provide a more stable game environment.
Thank you.

tags.bug: We have found out the issue where the resurrection currencies, 'Gold', 'Star Seed', and 'Recovery Scroll', were repeatedly decreased if players tried to be resurrected while a lag issue was occuring.

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 25th (PDT)
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

A server patch was performed at around August 25th, 6PM (PDT) / August 26th, 3AM (CEST) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.

[h3][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[b][Quest][/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where if one dies and resurrects at a Soul Pyre while performing the Ivory Dunes main quest Join the Rebellion, the quest can no longer be continued.
[*]Fixed a bug where if regional quests are freshed while one has regional quests in progress, the new regional quests cannot be obtained.
[*]Fixed a bug where if one fails while performing the quest Calamity of Kannus, the quest cannot be continued. 
[*]Reduced the wait time for the Invasion quests that may be activated all over the world from 8 hours to 4 hours. However, it will still take 8 hours for the initial Invasion quest to be activated after a server restart. After the initial activation, it will only take 4 hours. 

[b][UI/UX][/b]
[*]Increased the stackable amount of potions, cooking, lunchboxes, and enhancement material items in the bag from 20 to 100.
[*]Go to the Consumables tab in your Bag, then use the Sort > Organize Items function to reorganize the stackable amount of items.
[*]Fixed a bug where when moving to the Shop’s buy and sell tabs, the sell all list from before is still there.

[b][Crusader][/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where Crusader's Class Skill Brave Judge's effect would not activate due to the Lionheart Blessing skill Roar of the Lion shout-type skill damage.
[*]Fixed a bug where when Dauntless Charge is used while the Crusader Mark of the Wolf blessing is equipped, the bleeding effect resulting from the Razor Claw effect can also be applied to yourself.
[*]Fixed a bug where some of the values for the next level of the Crusader Mark of the World blessing Fang of the Wolf effect is the same as the previous level.

[b][Berserker][/b]
Fixed a bug where the skill Shoulder Strike is not activated when the Berserker is using combo skills.

[b][Mage][/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where the beneficial effects of the skills Frozen Solid, Chain Explosion, Madness of Fire, Chosen by Flame from among the Mage’s blessing effects, are not being applied according to the refresh cycle.

[b][Ranger][/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where the effect of Overload from the Ranger Mark of the Wolf blessing’s is not activated if the Class Skill Quick Hands is equipped.
[*]Fixed a bug where the effect of Overload from the Ranger Mark of the Wolf blessing’s is not activated during the skill Thundering Arrows’s critical hit.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Ranger's Lightning Arrow skill's cooldown reduction effect was not applied if the skill was used more than once due to the Crescent Moon blessing’s Accumulate effect.

[b][Priest][/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where the Priest class skill Blades of Justice’s critical rate was not applied due to the Gift of Valor blessing’s Righteous Judgement effect not functioning properly.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Priest class skill Blades of Justice was recovering Holy Energy multiple times.
[*]Fixed a bug where the continuous healing effect is not applied if one evades while receiving the effect of the Priest Healing Sphere skill. 

[b][Monster][/b]
[*]Increased the combat area of the field boss Harpy Queen and Twisted Void Harpy Queen to reduce the possibility of resets during combat.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Padana Ruins Grayfog Wolf would recognize players but sometimes not attack.
[*]Reduced the spawn rate of the monsters Enraged Mineral Spirit, Enraged Tree Spirit, Enraged Parasitic Plant, and Bloomed Grass Fairy that would appear at a chance when gathering after Tristezza to 25% less than before. Their attack power has also been slightly reduced. 

[b][Fishing][/b]
[*]Added a hotspot to the Carzacor Lower Ribus River fishing spot 
[*]Fixed a bug where fishing hotspot locations were not refreshing normally.

[b][Summer Event][/b]
[*]Reduced the HP of the summer event’s Flame Saurin Sentinel and Flame Saurin Sentinel by 20% 
[*]Fixed a bug where the color of the Passionate Beach Swimsuit costume would change if costume fusion was successful and the item grade was increased. 

[b][Other][/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where a crash would occur if one entered the portal when the dungeon results window appears after clearing the dungeon.
[*]Fixed a bug where the client would sometimes close if attempts to change channels or teleport are made while a marker set by a party member is on the World Map.
[*]Fixed a bug where cooking items intended for use at the Soul Pyre could be used in the Bag.
[*]Fixed a bug where the mouse rotation is not possible if one enters the dungeon with the Ring Menu open.

This announcement will be updated, or a new announcement made if there are additional updates.

Thank you.

notes.title: Known Issues - August 23th
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Adventurers,
[/b][/h2]
We thank you for your support and interest in Bless Unleashed PC.
We want to inform the community regarding the known issues occurred in the world of Bless Unleashed PC.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and we will try to fix the issues as soon as possible.
See the details below.


[h2][b][Known Issues as of August 23th, 2021][/b][/h2]
- The causes of these known issues have already been figured out, and it will be fixed through a patch.

[b]1. When Crusader’s “Final Strike” skill is used right after using Shout skills while “Gift of Valor” Blessing is activated, the skill is sometimes not used with the maximum charge.

2. When players repeatedly use a skill whose effect lasts by holding a button, the effect continues even after releasing the button.

3. When Priest’s skill is used right after “Shield of Faith” is used while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is activated, cooldown is sometimes applied to the skill.

4. For the daily delivery quest of “Shield of the Mountain”, “Totem of the Mountain”, “Quiver of the Mountain”, “Halidom of the Mountain” and “Magic Orb of the Mountain”, the crafting materials on the quest description are different from the actual one.
[/b]

[b][Fix Complete][/b]
- Players cannot continue the “Clear the Canyon” quest, story quest of Ivory Dunes, when they die during the quest. This issue can be fixed after restarting the game.
- When the grade of “Passionate Beach Swimsuit” is increased by a success of fusion, the color changes from violet to yellow.
- The Shoulder Strike skill is not activated if one evades while using combo attacks as a Berserker.
- Ranger’s “Overload” passive skill is not activated when “Quick Hands” passive is equipped.

Check out the FAQ below to see the issues currently known in Bless Unleashed PC.

[url=https://blessunleashedpc.oqupie.com/portals/907/articles/28134]▶ Current Known Issues[/url]

We apologize for the inconvenience, and we will make efforts to give you a better service.

Thank you.

3. When Priest’s skill is used right after “Shield of Faith” is used while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is activated, cooldown is sometimes applied to the skill.

4. For the daily delivery quest of “Shield of the Mountain”, “Totem of the Mountain”, “Quiver of the Mountain”, “Halidom of the Mountain” and “Magic Orb of the Mountain”, the crafting materials on the quest description are different from the actual one.

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 23th (PDT)
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

A server patch was performed at around August 23th, 6PM (PDT) / August 20th, 3AM (CEST) as a response to issues found in the current game version.

Please check out the details below.



[h3][b]■ Patch Notes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Modified so that the field boss Ursa now drops crafting material items. 
[*] Modified so that equipment effects that used to apply to nearby allies are now applied to the party.
[*] Fixed a bug where cases of other characters entering personal estates were found even though they weren’t supposed to.
[*] Fixed a bug where when resurrecting during lags, the Gold, Starseed, or Recovery Scrolls used for resurrecting were sometimes consumed multiple times.
[*] Performed fixes to reduce the amount of lag that occured when multiple players are fighting with a field boss.
[*] Performed fixes to reduce the amount of lag overall.
[/list]
We will do our best to provide a better environment for your game play.
Further updates will be provided through either this or another announcement.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 19th (PDT)
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

As some issues were found, a non-maintenance patch has been performed on August 19th (PDT).

Please check out the details below.


[h3][b]■ Patch Notes[/b][/h3]

[b][Paid Items][/b]
[*] Some tradable items from Founder’s Pack are now not tradable.
- Basic Star Seed Booster (30 Days)
- Advanced Star Seed Booster (30 Days)
- Personal Storage Expansion Ticket
- Account Storage Expansion Ticket
- Bag Expansion Ticket


[*] Changed so that other classes also can open “Crusader of Victory Weapon Appearance Chest”. Items received from opening the chest can be used in fusion or sold on the marketplace.
[*] Fixed a bug where “Grimjaw” Mount that can be purchased from Limited Shop in Lumena Shop cannot be found in Stable.
[*] Fixed an issue where the amount of some given items from Founder’s Pack was not displaying correctly after purchasing the Founder’s Pack. Those items were still given with the correct amount.


[b][Priest][/b]
[*] Changed for Priest so that obtaining a resource by using a skill is not available during a protective shield effect while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is activated. Holy Energy can be recovered if combos are used.
[*]Changed for Priest so that HP is decreased once at first when “Retribution” skill is used while “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is activated.
[*]The duration of a protective shield of Priest’s “Shield of Faith” skill is increased from 12 sec to 14 sec. 
[*] The cost of Holy Energy for Priest’s “Shield of Faith” skill is changed from 600 to 450. 
[*] Fixed a bug for Priest’s “Shield of Faith” where the gauge of protective shield was not displaying correctly when the protective shield was refreshed while the protective shield gauge was not fully consumed.
[*] Fixed a bug where Holy Energy was not recovered when Priest’s “Healing Wave” skill was used.
[*] Fixed a bug for “Burning Judgment” effect of Priest’s “The Lionheart” Blessing where HP recovery is not activated when the level of Judgment skill is 10 and above.
[*] Modified the amount of HP consumed by the Priest’s Mark of the Wolf Blessing - Protection and Sacrifice effect

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/81a804716476c6ed156d4ba50b0e0787a47bd71c.png[/img]

[b][Berserker][/b]
[*] Fixed a bug for Berserker where the skill motion of “Furious Earthbreaker” and “Relentless Cleave” was sometimes not properly activated while the “Preheat” effect in “Mark of the Wolf” Blessing is activated.


[b][Crusader][/b]
[*] Fixed a bug for Crusader where the “Overwhelming Defense” effect in “Lionheart Legacy” Blessing was not activated when “Impervious” passive skill was equipped.


[b][Berserker/Crusader][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage may be abnormally accumulated when the effect of Damage over Time that can be overlapped such as “Hemorrhage” effect of Crusader and Berserker or “Holy Flame” skill of Priest is refreshed. 


[b][Text][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the complete message of “Navarran Cuisine” quest was not properly displaying.


[b][Monster][/b]
[*] Lowered HP of the field Boss “Soulraiser Revenant” since it was set higher than planned.
Fixed an issue where defeating a monster lower than your character level gave out more EXP than intended. 
[*] Fixed an issue where defeating a monster higher than your character level gave out less EXP than intended.
[*]Fixed an issue where the “Bound” option was not indicated in the description of some crafting materials from Unique Bosses.
[*]Changed so that players can fight with the field Elite boss “Black Knight” only within the arena created when the combat starts. The enemies outside the arena will be disregarded and the attacks from outside the arena won’t inflict any damage.


[b][Quest][/b]
[*] Changed so that the quest item “Meyhen's Abrasive” and “Shiny Slime Mucus” cannot be stored in Account Storage and they cannot be salvaged.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Gathering Evidence” quest couldn’t be completed because the “Joaquin” NPC was missing during the “Lost And Found” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue where the episode quest ‘Stop the Sacrifice’ could not be progressed while the Zenkala main quest was being performed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the quest could not be progressed when the Ivory Dunes main quest was in progress. 
[*]Fixed a problem where the quest progress was blocked if users quit the game during the directing cutscene to see Ilene’s garden in the Touch of Lily'anthes 3 quest. Also, when logging out or leaving the quest area, the quest will fail and change back to the state where the user can receive the quest again from Ilene. 
[*]During Beoran’s main quest ‘Guard the Griffin’, the quest failure conditions of talking to the baby griffon and defeating the Faceless Trackers have been added. When dying, logging out, or leaving the quest area, the quest will fail and change back to the stage where it can be performed normally again.
Fixed an issue where the Faceless Trackers would respawn at regular intervals during Beoran’s main quest.
[*]Added a quest failure condition for killing Rafael and Archfiend during Tristezza’s main quest ‘The Great Ritual’. Upon death or logout, the quest will fail and change back to the stage where it can be performed normally.
[*] Greatly increased the taming rate that is provided once when accepting the taming quest. Additionally, the taming quest has been changed so that a specific mark appears on the target that can be tamed until the quest is completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the item option of the Arbiter’s equipment item, which can be acquired as a reward for defeating the World Bosses quest, was missing or incorrectly applied.
[*] Fixed an issue where during the ancient weapon quest, the ancient weapon crafting did not proceed. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the quest ‘The Giant's Braid’ could be performed in the Alicorno Forest and Eidolon Forest regions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the buff effect applied during the taming quest disappeared when leaving the terrority. 
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to talk to NPC ‘Arisel’ during the ‘A New Friend’ quest.


[b][Campaign][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the mount ‘Black Bandana Panda’ which can be obtained as a reward from the campaign ‘Unending Conflict’ did not appear in the mount list after registration.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mount ‘ Shadowblade Alpha Wolf’ which can be obtained as a reward from the campaign ‘A Land of Legends’ did not appear in the mount list after registration. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the mount ‘Red Warg’ which can be obtained as a reward from the campaign ‘The Spear of Salvation’ did not appear in the mount list after registration. 


[b][Other][/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where when quickly moving in the character selection screen, an abnormal screen appeared.
[*] Fixed an issue where the initial value of the selected preset did not return to the initial value when the reset button was pressed during character creation customization. 
[*] Modified the waiting time for character deletion from 300 to 480 minutes for characters level 15 - 20. 
[*] Modified so the friends, party, and guild menus are not displayed when opening the estate main menu.
[*] The default setting of the [Video] > [Frame Limit] option in the [Options] menu has been changed from 30 to 60. Users who have previously set a frame limit option will remain the same.
[*] Fixed an issue where the client would shut down intermittently when closing crafting and enhancing related menus.
[*] Modified so that matchmaking is cancelled normally when moving channels while in the state of accepting matching entry.
[*] Modified so that the maximum number of characters that can be entered in chat is 90 characters.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to control the game when trying to bleach a dyed item.
[*] Modified so that the auction house price appears only up to 3 days in advance.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the party leader removed a dungeon cleared once from the matching list, it would not add to the list again.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Time Dungeon matching UI was not updated properly.


[b][Summer Event][/b]
- Fixed an issue where the summer event Flame Saurin Guardian would intermittently not disarm after using a shield just before death, making it impossible to defeat.
- Modified so that the summer event shabiki ice gift box can be participated from level 15 or higher.


We will do our best to provide a better environment for your game play.
Further updates will be provided through either this or another announcement.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Event] 2021 Summer Event: Salamander Solstice
notes.content:
[h3][b]With the weather getting hotter and hotter, cool off with Bless Unleashed PC’s special Salamander Solstice event! [/b][/h3]

Every year when the Salamanders appear, merchants of the Salamander Festival Committee gather to host a festival for all of Lumios to enjoy.

Take part for your chance to obtain amazing rewards such as the unique Salamander weapon appearances, and Passionate Beach Swimsuit and Headwear costumes. A variety of special rewards and benefits are also lined up so don’t miss out!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/f7f9e756f9851edfaf945d80b8381e7e904eb3aa.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]● Salamander Solstice Event Schedule[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]▶ Event Period[/b][/h3]
- August 18th  6PM  - September 15th, 6PM (PDT) 
- August 19th 3AM - September 16th, 3AM (CEST)




 
[h2][b]Event 1: Salamander Hunt[/b][/h2]

During the event period, Salamanders and their Flame Saurin protectors will appear all over the world of Lumios.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/5907e1120516aa3ede96cc39a834bc4b69f95c58.png[/img]
[b]- Salamander & Flame Saurin[/b]



[b]Defeat event monsters to obtain Salamander Coins (event coins) [/b]that can be exchanged for a variety of rewards at the Salamander Solstice Event Merchant. 

In addition to Salamander Coins, Salamanders and Flame Saurins may also drop Salamander Nest Map Fragments when defeated. Gather 8 pieces and bring them to an Event Cartographer to restore them into Salamander Treasure Maps. Follow the treasure map to find even more event coins!

[b]※Notes[/b]
[b]Event monsters may spawn at a chance when killing normal monsters.[/b]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/4c96656ec1d9977e864d0fbed7dcf6cc55693766.png[/img]
[h3][b]▶ Summer Event Merchants Jinjin and Mantha[/b][/h3]

[b]Tip: Unused coins will remain in the user’s inventory even after the event ends, and can be used again when the event is held in the future.[/b]



 
[h2][b]Event 2.  Summer Fishing Competition[/b][/h2]
For players who aren’t into hunting, they can take part in the summer event fishing competition!
While participating in the fishing competition, catch and salvage the three summer event fishes Clown Anemonefish, Large-Eye Dentex, and Jewelfish to obtain event coins.



[b]※Notes[/b]
- Summer event fish can only be caught at the Tremont Fishing Hole in Sperios. 
- The summer event fishing competition held at the Tremont Fishing Hole in Sperios lasts from August 17th  6PM  - September 15th, 6PM (PDT) / August 18th 3AM - September 16th, 3AM (CEST).

 

[b][Summer Event Notes][/b]
- The ​​Salamander Solstice Event Merchant and Salamander Solstice Map Merchant will continue to be available in-game until 1 week after the event ends for users to exchange remaining event coins for rewards.
- The Passionate Beach Swimsuit and Headwear costume, and Salamander weapon appearance rewards may be obtained at a chance whenever the Salamander Solstice Event Chest II is used. 
Participation in the event does not guarantee receipt of rewards. These rewards are not participation rewards.
 



[h1][b]Special Summer Event Content★[/b][/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/c07e46079140c59a63c7024b84ab0f61040fcd40.png[/img]
[h2][b]1. Salamander Totem[/b][/h2]

[b]Check out the Salamander Totems that appeared on Lumios![/b]
Use 100 Salamander Coins at the totem to obtain a random buff. This buff will not only be applied to you, but also every character located within 8m of the totem. Make use of this event feature to obtain and share buffs with your party members!

Using the totem offers the chance to randomly obtain one of a variety of possible buffs, such as the popular Attack Power increase, Critical Hit Rate increase, and PvE XP increase. 

If you would like to change the buff obtained, simply visit the Salamander Totem and interact with it again after a 3 minute cooldown.


※ Please note that although the buff applied can be changed by interacting with the Salamander Totem again, this will also change the buffs applied to each player located within 8m.






[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/b5aec8c6fa651f1bcbff6069bc3ad77a7af39622.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]2. Shabiki Ice Sculpture[/b][/h2]

Connect to the game everyday and interact with the Shabiki Ice Sculpture for your daily Salamander Solstice Event Chest II! 

Take advantage of this daily reward benefit to increase your chances of obtaining the event costume and weapon appearances from the Salamander Solstice Event Chest II! 

Shabiki Ice Sculptures are located in Carzacor, Navarra, the Gnoll Wastes, Tristezza, and Sperios.

[b]※ There is a cooltime of 22 hours after each time you interact with the Shabiki Ice Sculpture.[/b]






[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/aed40b024d91065a51bbe9737744d890916a11bb.png[/img]
[h2][b]3. Burning Ore[/b][/h2]

[b]Don’t pass by the next time you see the fiery Burning Ore![/b]

Mining the Burning Ore would cause an event monster to appear. Defeat the monster protecting the ore to obtain Salamander Coins and even Salamander Nest Map Fragments!

[b]※ Notes: Burning Ore appears at random after normal ore has been mined. [/b]

notes.title: [Delayed] August 17th - Update Plans Regarding Current Main Issues
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Adventurers,[/h3]

Please check out the details below on some of the current ongoing main issues in the game as well as our update plans. 

[b]1. Regarding the Priest Class Patch on August 15th [/b]
[list]
[*] When equipping the Priest Blessing 'Mark of the Wolf', the retribution skill will be changed to receive the HP consumption effect only once when cast.
[*] Originally, a bug preventing HP from decreasing was found, and a patch was carried out on August 15th.
[*] However, we found out afterwards that the HP was being decreased several times unintentionally, so a patch to fix this bug is currently being prepared.

[*] While we were looking into this issue, there needed to be a rebalance for the “Shield of Faith” skill.
[*] We are currently modifying so that a protective shield effect will easily be activated in a desired stage, will last longer to improve convenience, and won’t be used unlimitedly.
[/list]
[b]2. A found bug where the “Overwhelming Defense” effect is not applied when the Crusader’s passive skill “Impervious” is activated will be fixed.[/b]

[b]3. We are already aware that players are having issues defeating the Bone Dragon due to a lag issue occurring during combat.[/b]
[list]
[*] A technical review is currently ongoing to fix this issue with top priority, and we will make efforts to provide excitement of defeating the Bone Dragon in a stable gaming environment.
[/list]
[b]4. Regarding restricting an advertisement for Star Seed selling websites.[/b]
[list]
[*] Buying/selling Star Seeds with real money is strictly prohibited in Bless Unleashed PC. We are aware that players are not able to experience a normal chatting service due to repeated advertisements by some Star Seed selling websites.
[*] We will continue to monitor those characters with real money trading chats 24/7 applying a penalty of an account ban for maximum 30 days. We are also internally preparing to enhance a chat filtering system against the real money trading chats.
[/list]

Please note that from the issues mentioned above, #1 and #2 will be updated through the August 18th maintenance, and #3 and #4 will be updated as soon as possible.

We will always make efforts to listen to user feedback and provide a better service and gameplay experience.

=======================================
[h3][b][2021.08.18][/b][/h3]
- The current fix for the upcoming patch is taking a little longer than expected, so please note that the maintanence mentioned above will be delayed by one day. (August 19th)
We ask for your understanding as we are working on fixing the issues as fast as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Known Issues - August 13th
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

We thank you for your support and interest in Bless Unleashed PC.
We want to inform the community regarding the known issues occurred in the world of Bless Unleashed PC.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and we will try to fix the issues as soon as possible.
See the details below.


[h2][b][Known Issues as of August 13th, 2021][/b][/h2]

The causes of these known issues have already been figured out, and it will be fixed through a patch.

1. Legendary “Breath” items cannot be fused, but the tooltip of Legendary “Breath” items says that they can be upgraded to a higher-grade Breath through a Fusion Specialist.

2. Fusing some Legendary costumes has a chance to obtain a Rare Appearance, but this description is missing.

3. Crusader’s Counterattack skills break combos when it is used during combos, but the skill description says that “This skill does not break combos even when it is used during a combo.”.

4. Crusader’s “Dauntless Charge” skill can be used max. 2 times in a row, but this description is missing.

5. Berserker’s “Charge” skill will get “Interrupt Immunity” effect when its level reaches 25, but this description is missing.

6. As Berserker’s “Overpower” skill is upgraded, the movement speed reduction effect increases. But this description is missing.
[b][Movement Speed Reduction effect by Level][/b]
[list]
[*] - Lv.1 ~ 9 :  Movement Speed -10% for 5 sec
[*] - Lv. 10 ~ 19 : Movement Speed -20% for 6.5 sec
[*] - Lv. 20 and above: Movement Speed -30% for 8 sec
[/list]
7. Some description of Berserker’s “Rushing Storm” skill is different from the actual effect.
[list]
[*] Description: the stack is consumed when Whirlwind is used.
[*] Correction: the stack is consumed when Whirlwind hits the enemy.
[/list]
8. Even the “Encouragement” passive skill of Ranger’s “Lionheart Legacy” Blessings is applied to the target, the timed effect for “Reduced Attack Power” is not displayed.

9. Some description of Mage’s “Arcane Lightning” skill is different from the actual effect.
[list]
[*] Description: Damages nearby enemies.
[*] Actual target: Damages a single enemy.
[/list]
10. Some equipment items that enhance Priest’s “Blades of Justice” skill don’t have a description for skill enhancement.
[list]
[*] Enhancement Effect: “Decreases Attack Power of hit targets -7%.
[*] Items: “Faded Halidom of the Forgotten”, “Faded Storm Punisher Halidom”
[/list]
11. “Interdimensional Luggage”, “Bigger on the Inside”, “Multidimensional Bag” Achievement don’t have a description that it’s permanently affected by expanded bag slots.

12. After “Touch of Lily'anthes 2” Quest fails, the Quest location icon disappears from the map.
- The quest will be automatically accepted when you re-enter West Alicorno Forest where Ilene's garden is located.

13. A word “Void” is missing from the name of “Defeat the Twisted Boss” achievement in the Achievement menu.

[b][Mistyped][/b]
[list]
[*] - Twisted Grasslands Giant, Twisted Harpy Queen, Twisted Bashal, Twisted Giant Cyclops
[/list]
[b][Correction][/b]
[list]
[*] - Twisted Void Grasslands Giant, Twisted Void Harpy Queen, Twisted Void Bashal, Twisted Void Giant Cyclops
[/list]
14. “Black Bandana Panda” Mount can be obtained as a Campaign reward, but the obtaining location information is not provided.

15. Although the “Crafting XP Increase” effect is applied, the applied effect is not reflected on the crafting UI.

16. In the “Applied Effect” menu, the tooltip of the applied effects is not showing although you click or mouse over them.

17. When you go to the lobby while the costume is hidden, the costume is still showing in the lobby.

18. “Preview costume” feature on Crusader Weapon Appearance in Lumena Shop is not working for Crusader class.

19. The name of Premium Bless Pass Reward Chest is mistyped with “Season 5”.

[b][FIX COMPLETE][/b] 20. The game client unexpectedly closes on a cinematic scene during some quests.
- As a temporary solution, go to Settings > Graphics and change the setting for the “Frame Rate Limit” to 45.


We apologize for the inconvenience, and we will make efforts to give you a better service.

Thank you.

notes.title: Final Improvements: Combat, Content, UI/UX Convenience
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, Adventurers![/b][/h2]

[b]First of all, we would like to express our thanks to everyone for your continued support of Bless Unleashed PC.[/b]

From the first CBTs until the most recent Final Test, players from all over the world have joined us in testing the game, providing us opportunities to thoroughly prepare for launch. As mentioned in our “Letter From Bless Unleashed PC Head of Development”, we have since closely reviewed all player feedback from the Final Test to help us better prepare the game.

Today, we will be sharing current developments in even greater detail than mentioned in the previous “Letter From Bless Unleashed PC Head of Development”. We hope this will give everyone more to look forward to at the official launch!




[h2][b]“Improvements on Combat Progression, Action, and Fatigue”[/b][/h2]

Bless Unleashed PC is enhancing an action mechanism by the class-unique combos and skills and the combination of Blessings. Some parts were already available during the Final Test for playerss to experience, but the following have never been revealed before.

[h3][b]Blessing and Skill Effect Improvements (Key Point)[/b][/h3]
Each Blessing will have their own specialized skills and control mechanism to provide players a variety of combat experiences without the need to switch characters.


[Priest: Blessing Skill Preview]
[previewyoutube=oA8Q6_dvsqo;full][/previewyoutube]

[Crusader: Blessing Skill Preview]
[previewyoutube=7umerJ1MVeU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]Combat Information Improvements[/b][/h2]
[u][b]Blessings[/b][/u] - Information on the Blessing’s method of acquisition, next level progression values, and tips and information on usage will be added.
[u][b]Skills[/b][/u] - Players will now be able to see the next level progression values.

Based on feedback from the Final Test, we are currently working on adjusting the balance, difficulty, 

fluidity and delay of controls to lessen overall combat fatigue. We are aware that combat fatigue must be reduced for an even better gaming experience, and that balance must be improved to make the game more enjoyable.

Instead of drastically reducing the difficulty level to resolve the issue, we are fine-tuning to prevent affecting the overall tension of the game. Early parts of the game, which are considered areas where players are still learning, will see their difficulty level reduced. 

For example, drop rates for better items will be higher, and combat areas for group hunting may be expanded to make it easier to defeat field bosses.


[Berserker: Blessing Skill Preview]
[previewyoutube=IMjoHQ4GLlc;full][/previewyoutube]

We are also finishing up on the combat mechanisms of certain classes, and are considering various methods to help players easily and quickly learn, understand, and familiarize themselves with the unique Bless Unleashed PC combat system that utilizes combos, skills and evading.


[Priest: New Combo Preview]
[previewyoutube=4zvHrRW-T74;full][/previewyoutube]


Aside from the above, there are many more specific improvements being made to evading, skill connection and combo delay to reduce combat fatigue.




[h2][b]“Overall Improvements in Content Polishing and Experience”[/b][/h2]

One of the main points of feedback we received about the Final Test was that both dungeon and field monsters were overpowered, causing players to experience high combat fatigue. We are aware of this, and it was not what we originally intended. As a result, changes will be made so that players who are ready for dungeons will be able to succeed in their challenge much easier than before.

[h3][b]1) First, a different combat experience will be given for each dungeon type.[/b][/h3]
Improvements will be made so that Arenas will provide a casual combat experience, Lairs and Dungeons will involve an adequate amount of urgency, and Abyssal Dungeons will be an opportunity for experienced players to test their strategies and combat ability. 

The difficulty level of low-level dungeons have also been reduced. However this is more than simply reducing the Attack Power or Defense of field and dungeon monsters. Detailed balance adjustments will also be made to provide an entertaining experience without making it too easy. 

[h3][b]2) Improvements are also being made to the combat experience of unique field bosses.[/b][/h3]
We will be removing the berserk effect of unique bosses to allow players with various skills and items to fight a common-enemy together. 

The negative combat experience of dealing only minimal damage while at the risk of dying from only one hit from the berserk boss will be eliminated for a more dynamic combat experience. 

That being said, mutated Twisted type unique bosses such as the Twisted Harpy Queen that appear periodically will continue to remain as powerful monsters. Their difficulty level will be slightly reduced from what players experienced during the Final Test, but it will continue to be a challenge for well-prepared players. The Twisted bosses will still go berserk, but the effect’s impact and speed will be reduced. 


[Twisted Field Bosses]
[previewyoutube=XbbYKjFlOAI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]3) The early parts of the game are rather boring compared to the quests, dungeons, and field content from later on in the game. [/b][/h3]

A variety of changes are being implemented to improve the engagement of the early parts of the game. Changes are made with two major points in mind. 

[h3][b]#1 - Improve the quest flow of the early parts of the game[/b][/h3]
We are working to create links between incidents that occur in the world of Bless Unleashed PC to form a strong storyline that will motivate players to continue playing the game. A variety of factors are also being utilized to create motivation for players to regularly continue their adventure in Bless Unleashed PC. 

For example, parts that are unnecessary for the storyline or which were found to be boring for gameplay will be removed or adjusted to increase interest during the early and middle stages. 

How the storyline of Bless Unleashed PC is being conveyed to our players, and other small inconveniences are also being closely reviewed and changed. 

[Gathering Event]
[previewyoutube=NhRMqc4OgtI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]#2 - General changes to dungeon entry levels[/b][/h3]
The amount of dungeons that are available at a lower level will be increased, and the entry period for some dungeons will also be changed to allow players the option to take on difficult dungeons regularly and gradually. 

Efforts are also underway to appropriately balance the difficulty level and provide suitable rewards as part of a satisfying dungeon experience.





[h2][b]“Continuous Improvement of UI/UX and Convenience”[/b][/h2]

Although we have been working on improving the UI/UX, we realized that some parts are still falling short.
Therefore we are continuing towards the goal of optimizing it for PC while keeping things convenient for our users. 

A detailed discussion on changing the UI completely like many have mentioned was also held internally. However, as you all know, modifying the entire layout is a huge task that requires a lot of time and effort, meaning that although we are trying our best, we ask for your understanding as the results may not be enough to satisfy our users.

Currently, priority is placed on improving parts that are helpful to our players, and removing aspects that interrupted gameplay. An assortment of improvements are also ongoing with the goal of making Bless Unleashed PC a game that can be played comfortably on the PC platform.

The most obvious changes will be the menu and screen composition.

Many players mentioned that it was difficult to navigate the menus, so we are improving menu accessibility along with making screen composition much easier to use.


[Proposed Menu Design]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/7877c7810d3e2f4e6a43c79a98f97ce5dd0cea0c.jpg[/img]

The biggest inconvenience players mentioned was the small number of quests that could be displayed. As a response we will be increasing the amount of quests that can be shown. 

Improvements are also being made to keyboard and mouse control to increase consistency and convenience. In addition, players will now be able to interact with NPCs while riding a mount, and the delivery of in-game information such as the skill cooldown time and mount button location will also see improvements.




[h2][b]“Other Important Improvements”[/b][/h2]

Aside from the major key improvements mentioned above, many other issues raised from player feedback are also being addressed.

[h3][b]1) Improvements will be made to the high temperature and increased usage of graphic cards. [/b][/h3]

This was brought up by many players. Although settings ideal for the PC environment were available during the Final Test, we were unable to accommodate all the different player environments. We also noticed that GPU usage was higher than required due to the unfixed frame rate.

To resolve this issue, we will add an option for a fixed frame rate, provide users a default setting suitable for their PC environment by tuning performance detection, and make it possible for players to change custom settings early on. We expect these changes to prevent the issue from recurring. 

[h3][b]2) Efforts are underway to improve the three-dimensional effect of shadows according to the time of day. [/b][/h3]

Day and night exists in Bless Unleashed PC, and one of our goals is to showcase the diverse beauty and charms of all areas.
There are lights that turn on only at night, and we worked to portray each dungeon in their unique style. Nonetheless, there are still parts for improvement as mentioned by our players. 

An overall review of art quality and optimization is being performed, and changes are also made to portray the NPCs in further detail. Rather than working on one specific part, we are aiming to better the game overall. We predict that many of the points mentioned by our players will be greatly improved.

[Time of Day and Lighting Improvements]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/ba60d28b7098905d0b88bc652917f7f0cc2c18c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/5f0b48c0f6fcddd40160f6e0b1cac3bff40a0a3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/28704f697db0e699308e59b8f94d0b9494befb61.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190702/eaf55abd2a06777268e3c6fb9d5f01f381bb5c30.png[/img]


[h3][b]3) Changes will be made to integrated matchmaking in the global environment where communication was difficult.[/b][/h3]

The original intention during the Final Test was to increase matchmaking speed by integrating matchmaking systems between multiple regions. However due to the amount of languages involved, there were communication difficulties between players. 

We attempted to resolve this issue as much as possible by implementing an emoticon system, but the communication issues ended up taking away the fun of playing as a group, and made the dungeons even harder to complete.

As a result we will be applying changes so that matchmaking is only available within the same server in the same region. We hope that this will prevent players from experiencing difficulty in gameplay due to language barriers like we saw in the Final Test.




Through the multiple CBTs and tests over the past few months, we have been working to slowly but surely improve the PC optimization and game of Bless Unleashed PC while communicating with our players. Once again, thank you for staying with us.

This will not be the last time improvements are made to Bless Unleashed PC. Will continue to communicate with our players and prepare the game to the best of our ability for official launch. 

Please continue to provide us with your feedback and support so that we can continue to make Bless Unleashed PC a great game together.


Thank you.
